6 # Cross-platform case-sensitive path canonicalization
7
8 if Sys.isunix() && !Sys.isapple()
9 # assume case-sensitive filesystems, don't have to do anything
10 isfile_casesensitive(path) = isaccessiblefile(path)
11 elseif Sys.iswindows()
12 # GetLongPathName Win32 function returns the case-preserved filename on NTFS.
13 function isfile_casesensitive(path)
14 isaccessiblefile(path) || return false # Fail fast
15 basename(Filesystem.longpath(path)) == basename(path)
16 end
17 elseif Sys.isapple()
18 # HFS+ filesystem is case-preserving. The getattrlist API returns
19 # a case-preserved filename. In the rare event that HFS+ is operating
20 # in case-sensitive mode, this will still work but will be redundant.
21
22 # Constants from <sys/attr.h>
23 const ATRATTR_BIT_MAP_COUNT = 5
24 const ATTR_CMN_NAME = 1
25 const BITMAPCOUNT = 1
26 const COMMONATTR = 5
27 const FSOPT_NOFOLLOW = 1 # Don't follow symbolic links
28
29 const attr_list = zeros(UInt8, 24)
30 attr_list[BITMAPCOUNT] = ATRATTR_BIT_MAP_COUNT
31 attr_list[COMMONATTR] = ATTR_CMN_NAME
32
33 # This essentially corresponds to the following C code:
34 # attrlist attr_list;
35 # memset(&attr_list, 0, sizeof(attr_list));
36 # attr_list.bitmapcount = ATTR_BIT_MAP_COUNT;
37 # attr_list.commonattr = ATTR_CMN_NAME;
38 # struct Buffer {
39 # u_int32_t total_length;
40 # u_int32_t filename_offset;
41 # u_int32_t filename_length;
42 # char filename[max_filename_length];
43 # };
44 # Buffer buf;
45 # getattrpath(path, &attr_list, &buf, sizeof(buf), FSOPT_NOFOLLOW);
46 function isfile_casesensitive(path)
47 isaccessiblefile(path) || return false
48 path_basename = String(basename(path))
49 local casepreserved_basename
50 header_size = 12
51 buf = Vector{UInt8}(undef, length(path_basename) + header_size + 1)
52 while true
53 ret = ccall(:getattrlist, Cint,
54 (Cstring, Ptr{Cvoid}, Ptr{Cvoid}, Csize_t, Culong),
55 path, attr_list, buf, sizeof(buf), FSOPT_NOFOLLOW)
56 systemerror(:getattrlist, ret ≠ 0)
57 filename_length = GC.@preserve buf unsafe_load(
58 convert(Ptr{UInt32}, pointer(buf) + 8))
59 if (filename_length + header_size) > length(buf)
60 resize!(buf, filename_length + header_size)
61 continue
62 end
63 casepreserved_basename =
64 view(buf, (header_size+1):(header_size+filename_length-1))
65 break
66 end
67 # Hack to compensate for inability to create a string from a subarray with no allocations.
68 codeunits(path_basename) == casepreserved_basename && return true
69
70 # If there is no match, it's possible that the file does exist but HFS+
71 # performed unicode normalization. See https://developer.apple.com/library/mac/qa/qa1235/_index.html.
72 isascii(path_basename) && return false
73 codeunits(Unicode.normalize(path_basename, :NFD)) == casepreserved_basename
74 end
75 else
76 # Generic fallback that performs a slow directory listing.
77 function isfile_casesensitive(path)
78 isaccessiblefile(path) || return false
79 dir, filename = splitdir(path)
80 any(readdir(dir) .== filename)
81 end
82 end

115 struct SHA1
116 bytes::NTuple{20, UInt8}
117 end
118 function SHA1(bytes::Vector{UInt8})
119 length(bytes) == 20 ||
120 throw(ArgumentError("wrong number of bytes for SHA1 hash: $(length(bytes))"))
121 return SHA1(ntuple(i->bytes[i], Val(20)))
122 end
123 SHA1(s::AbstractString) = SHA1(hex2bytes(s))
124 parse(::Type{SHA1}, s::AbstractString) = SHA1(s)
125 function tryparse(::Type{SHA1}, s::AbstractString)
126 try
127 return parse(SHA1, s)
128 catch e
129 if isa(e, ArgumentError)
130 return nothing
131 end
132 rethrow(e)
133 end
134 end

136 string(hash::SHA1) = bytes2hex(hash.bytes)
137 print(io::IO, hash::SHA1) = bytes2hex(io, hash.bytes)
138 show(io::IO, hash::SHA1) = print(io, "SHA1(\"", hash, "\")")
139
140 isless(a::SHA1, b::SHA1) = isless(a.bytes, b.bytes)
141 hash(a::SHA1, h::UInt) = hash((SHA1, a.bytes), h)
142 ==(a::SHA1, b::SHA1) = a.bytes == b.bytes

144 # fake uuid5 function (for self-assigned UUIDs)
145 # TODO: delete and use real uuid5 once it's in stdlib
146
147 function uuid5(namespace::UUID, key::String)
148 u::UInt128 = 0
149 h = hash(namespace)
150 for _ = 1:sizeof(u)÷sizeof(h)
151 u <<= sizeof(h) << 3
152 u |= (h = hash(key, h))
153 end
154 u &= 0xffffffffffff0fff3fffffffffffffff
155 u |= 0x00000000000050008000000000000000
156 return UUID(u)
157 end

182 ## package path slugs: turning UUID + SHA1 into a pair of 4-byte "slugs" ##
183
184 const slug_chars = String(['A':'Z'; 'a':'z'; '0':'9'])
185
186 function slug(x::UInt32, p::Int)
187 y::UInt32 = x
188 sprint(sizehint=p) do io
189 n = length(slug_chars)
190 for i = 1:p
191 y, d = divrem(y, n)
192 write(io, slug_chars[1+d])
193 end
194 end
195 end

197 function package_slug(uuid::UUID, p::Int=5)
198 crc = _crc32c(uuid)
199 return slug(crc, p)
200 end

202 function version_slug(uuid::UUID, sha1::SHA1, p::Int=5)
203 crc = _crc32c(uuid)
204 crc = _crc32c(sha1.bytes, crc)
205 return slug(crc, p)
206 end

208 mutable struct CachedTOMLDict
209 path::String
210 inode::UInt64
211 mtime::Float64
212 size::Int64
213 hash::UInt32
214 d::Dict{String, Any}
215 end
216
217 function CachedTOMLDict(p::TOML.Parser, path::String)
218 s = stat(path)
219 content = read(path)
220 crc32 = _crc32c(content)
221 TOML.reinit!(p, String(content); filepath=path)
222 d = TOML.parse(p)
223 return CachedTOMLDict(
224 path,
225 s.inode,
226 s.mtime,
227 s.size,
228 crc32,
229 d,
230 )
231 end
232
233 function get_updated_dict(p::TOML.Parser, f::CachedTOMLDict)
234 s = stat(f.path)
235 # note, this might miss very rapid in-place updates, such that mtime is
236 # identical but that is solvable by not doing in-place updates, and not
237 # rapidly changing these files
238 if s.inode != f.inode || s.mtime != f.mtime || f.size != s.size
239 content = read(f.path)
240 new_hash = _crc32c(content)
241 if new_hash != f.hash
242 f.inode = s.inode
243 f.mtime = s.mtime
244 f.size = s.size
245 f.hash = new_hash
246 TOML.reinit!(p, String(content); filepath=f.path)
247 return f.d = TOML.parse(p)
248 end
249 end
250 return f.d
251 end

277 parsed_toml(project_file::AbstractString) = parsed_toml(project_file, TOML_CACHE, require_lock)
278 function parsed_toml(project_file::AbstractString, toml_cache::TOMLCache, toml_lock::ReentrantLock)
279 lock(toml_lock) do
280 cache = LOADING_CACHE[]
281 dd = if !haskey(toml_cache.d, project_file)
282 d = CachedTOMLDict(toml_cache.p, project_file)
283 toml_cache.d[project_file] = d
284 d.d
285 else
286 d = toml_cache.d[project_file]
287 # We are in a require call and have already parsed this TOML file
288 # assume that it is unchanged to avoid hitting disk
289 if cache !== nothing && project_file in cache.require_parsed
290 d.d
291 else
292 get_updated_dict(toml_cache.p, d)
293 end
294 end
295 if cache !== nothing
296 push!(cache.require_parsed, project_file)
297 end
298 return dd
299 end
300 end

328 Base.identify_package_env(name::String)::Union{Tuple{PkgId, String}, Nothing}
329 Base.identify_package_env(where::Union{Module,PkgId}, name::String)::Union{Tuple{PkgId, Union{String, Nothing}}, Nothing}
330
331 Same as [`Base.identify_package`](@ref) except that the path to the environment where the package is identified
332 is also returned, except when the identity is not identified.
333 """
334 identify_package_env(where::Module, name::String) = identify_package_env(PkgId(where), name)
335 function identify_package_env(where::PkgId, name::String)
336 cache = LOADING_CACHE[]
337 if cache !== nothing
338 pkg_env = get(cache.identified_where, (where, name), missing)
339 pkg_env === missing || return pkg_env
340 end
341 pkg_env = nothing
342 if where.name === name
343 return (where, nothing)
344 elseif where.uuid === nothing
345 pkg_env = identify_package_env(name) # ignore `where`
346 else
347 for env in load_path()
348 pkgid = manifest_deps_get(env, where, name)
349 pkgid === nothing && continue # not found--keep looking
350 if pkgid.uuid !== nothing
351 pkg_env = pkgid, env # found in explicit environment--use it
352 end
353 break # found in implicit environment--return "not found"
354 end
355 if pkg_env === nothing && is_stdlib(where)
356 # if not found it could be that manifests are from a different julia version/commit
357 # where stdlib dependencies have changed, so look up deps based on the stdlib Project.toml
358 # as a fallback
359 pkg_env = identify_stdlib_project_dep(where, name)
360 end
361 end
362 if cache !== nothing
363 cache.identified_where[(where, name)] = pkg_env
364 end
365 return pkg_env
366 end
367 function identify_package_env(name::String)
368 cache = LOADING_CACHE[]
369 if cache !== nothing
370 pkg_env = get(cache.identified, name, missing)
371 pkg_env === missing || return pkg_env
372 end
373 pkg_env = nothing
374 for env in load_path()
375 pkg = project_deps_get(env, name)
376 if pkg !== nothing
377 pkg_env = pkg, env # found--return it
378 break
379 end
380 end
381 if cache !== nothing
382 cache.identified[name] = pkg_env
383 end
384 return pkg_env
385 end

387 function identify_stdlib_project_dep(stdlib::PkgId, depname::String)
388 @debug """
389 Stdlib $(repr("text/plain", stdlib)) is trying to load `$depname`
390 which is not listed as a dep in the load path manifests, so resorting to search
391 in the stdlib Project.tomls for true deps"""
392 stdlib_projfile = locate_project_file(joinpath(Sys.STDLIB, stdlib.name))
393 stdlib_projfile === nothing && return nothing
394 found = explicit_project_deps_get(stdlib_projfile, depname)
395 if found !== nothing
396 @debug "$(repr("text/plain", stdlib)) indeed depends on $depname in project $stdlib_projfile"
397 pkgid = PkgId(found, depname)
398 return pkgid, stdlib_projfile
399 end
400 return nothing
401 end

403 _nothing_or_first(x) = x === nothing ? nothing : first(x)
404
405 """
406 Base.identify_package(name::String)::Union{PkgId, Nothing}
407 Base.identify_package(where::Union{Module,PkgId}, name::String)::Union{PkgId, Nothing}
408
409 Identify the package by its name from the current environment stack, returning
410 its `PkgId`, or `nothing` if it cannot be found.
411
412 If only the `name` argument is provided, it searches each environment in the
413 stack and its named direct dependencies.
414
415 The `where` argument provides the context from where to search for the
416 package: in this case it first checks if the name matches the context itself,
417 otherwise it searches all recursive dependencies (from the resolved manifest of
418 each environment) until it locates the context `where`, and from there
419 identifies the dependency with the corresponding name.
420
421 ```julia-repl
422 julia> Base.identify_package("Pkg") # Pkg is a dependency of the default environment
423 Pkg [44cfe95a-1eb2-52ea-b672-e2afdf69b78f]
424
425 julia> using LinearAlgebra
426
427 julia> Base.identify_package(LinearAlgebra, "Pkg") # Pkg is not a dependency of LinearAlgebra
428 ```
429 """
430 identify_package(where::Module, name::String) = _nothing_or_first(identify_package_env(where, name))
431 identify_package(where::PkgId, name::String) = _nothing_or_first(identify_package_env(where, name))
432 identify_package(name::String) = _nothing_or_first(identify_package_env(name))
433
434 function locate_package_env(pkg::PkgId, stopenv::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing)::Union{Nothing,Tuple{String,String}}
435 cache = LOADING_CACHE[]
436 if cache !== nothing
437 pathenv = get(cache.located, (pkg, stopenv), missing)
438 pathenv === missing || return pathenv
439 end
440 path = nothing
441 env′ = nothing
442 if pkg.uuid === nothing
443 for env in load_path()
444 # look for the toplevel pkg `pkg.name` in this entry
445 found = project_deps_get(env, pkg.name)
446 if found !== nothing
447 @assert found.name == pkg.name
448 if found.uuid === nothing
449 # pkg.name is present in this directory or project file,
450 # return the path the entry point for the code, if it could be found
451 # otherwise, signal failure
452 path = implicit_manifest_uuid_path(env, pkg)
453 env′ = env
454 @goto done
455 end
456 end
457 if !(loading_extension || precompiling_extension)
458 stopenv == env && @goto done
459 end
460 end
461 else
462 for env in load_path()
463 path = manifest_uuid_path(env, pkg)
464 # missing is used as a sentinel to stop looking further down in envs
465 if path === missing
466 path = nothing
467 @goto done
468 end
469 if path !== nothing
470 path = entry_path(path, pkg.name)
471 env′ = env
472 @goto done
473 end
474 if !(loading_extension || precompiling_extension)
475 stopenv == env && break
476 end
477 end
478 # Allow loading of stdlibs if the name/uuid are given
479 # e.g. if they have been explicitly added to the project/manifest
480 mbypath = manifest_uuid_path(Sys.STDLIB, pkg)
481 if mbypath isa String
482 path = entry_path(mbypath, pkg.name)
483 env′ = Sys.STDLIB
484 @goto done
485 end
486 end
487 @label done
488 if cache !== nothing
489 cache.located[(pkg, stopenv)] = path === nothing ? nothing : (path, something(env′))
490 end
491 path === nothing && return nothing
492 return path, something(env′)
493 end

496 Base.locate_package(pkg::PkgId)::Union{String, Nothing}
497
498 The path to the entry-point file for the package corresponding to the identifier
499 `pkg`, or `nothing` if not found. See also [`identify_package`](@ref).
500
501 ```julia-repl
502 julia> pkg = Base.identify_package("Pkg")
503 Pkg [44cfe95a-1eb2-52ea-b672-e2afdf69b78f]

505 julia> Base.locate_package(pkg)

507 ```

509 function locate_package(pkg::PkgId, stopenv::Union{String, Nothing}=nothing)::Union{Nothing,String}

513 """
514 pathof(m::Module)
515
516 Return the path of the `m.jl` file that was used to `import` module `m`,
517 or `nothing` if `m` was not imported from a package.
518
519 Use [`dirname`](@ref) to get the directory part and [`basename`](@ref)
520 to get the file name part of the path.
521
522 See also [`pkgdir`](@ref).
523 """
524 function pathof(m::Module)
525 @lock require_lock begin
526 pkgid = get(module_keys, m, nothing)
527 pkgid === nothing && return nothing
528 origin = get(pkgorigins, pkgid, nothing)
529 origin === nothing && return nothing
530 path = origin.path
531 path === nothing && return nothing
532 return fixup_stdlib_path(path)
533 end
534 end
535
536 """
537 pkgdir(m::Module[, paths::String...])
538
539 Return the root directory of the package that declared module `m`,
540 or `nothing` if `m` was not declared in a package. Optionally further
541 path component strings can be provided to construct a path within the
542 package root.
543
544 To get the root directory of the package that implements the current module
545 the form `pkgdir(@__MODULE__)` can be used.
546
547 If an extension module is given, the root of the parent package is returned.
548
549 ```julia-repl
550 julia> pkgdir(Foo)
551 "/path/to/Foo.jl"
552
553 julia> pkgdir(Foo, "src", "file.jl")
554 "/path/to/Foo.jl/src/file.jl"
555 ```
556
557 See also [`pathof`](@ref).
558
559 !!! compat "Julia 1.7"
560 The optional argument `paths` requires at least Julia 1.7.
561 """
562 function pkgdir(m::Module, paths::String...)
563 rootmodule = moduleroot(m)
564 path = pathof(rootmodule)
565 path === nothing && return nothing
566 original = path
567 path, base = splitdir(dirname(path))
568 if base == "src"
569 # package source in `../src/Foo.jl`
570 elseif base == "ext"
571 # extension source in `../ext/FooExt.jl`
572 elseif basename(path) == "ext"
573 # extension source in `../ext/FooExt/FooExt.jl`
574 path = dirname(path)
575 else
576 error("Unexpected path structure for module source: $original")
577 end
578 return joinpath(path, paths...)
579 end

581 function get_pkgversion_from_path(path)
582 project_file = locate_project_file(path)
583 if project_file isa String
584 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
585 v = get(d, "version", nothing)
586 if v !== nothing
587 return VersionNumber(v::String)
588 end
589 end
590 return nothing
591 end

593 """
594 pkgversion(m::Module)
595
596 Return the version of the package that imported module `m`,
597 or `nothing` if `m` was not imported from a package, or imported
598 from a package without a version field set.
599
600 The version is read from the package's Project.toml during package
601 load.
602
603 To get the version of the package that imported the current module
604 the form `pkgversion(@__MODULE__)` can be used.
605
606 !!! compat "Julia 1.9"
607 This function was introduced in Julia 1.9.
608 """
609 function pkgversion(m::Module)
610 path = pkgdir(m)
611 path === nothing && return nothing
612 @lock require_lock begin
613 v = get_pkgversion_from_path(path)
614 pkgorigin = get(pkgorigins, PkgId(moduleroot(m)), nothing)
615 # Cache the version
616 if pkgorigin !== nothing && pkgorigin.version === nothing
617 pkgorigin.version = v
618 end
619 return v
620 end
621 end

625 const project_names = ("JuliaProject.toml", "Project.toml")
626 const manifest_names = (
627 "JuliaManifest-v$(VERSION.major).$(VERSION.minor).toml",
628 "Manifest-v$(VERSION.major).$(VERSION.minor).toml",
629 "JuliaManifest.toml",

634 function locate_project_file(env::String)
635 for proj in project_names
636 project_file = joinpath(env, proj)
637 if isfile_casesensitive(project_file)
638 return project_file
639 end
640 end
641 return true
642 end

644 # classify the LOAD_PATH entry to be one of:
645 # - `false`: nonexistent / nothing to see here
646 # - `true`: `env` is an implicit environment
647 # - `path`: the path of an explicit project file
648 function env_project_file(env::String)::Union{Bool,String}
649 @lock require_lock begin
650 cache = LOADING_CACHE[]
651 if cache !== nothing
652 project_file = get(cache.env_project_file, env, nothing)
653 project_file === nothing || return project_file
654 end
655 if isdir(env)
656 project_file = locate_project_file(env)
657 elseif basename(env) in project_names && isfile_casesensitive(env)
658 project_file = env
659 else
660 project_file = false
661 end
662 if cache !== nothing
663 cache.env_project_file[env] = project_file
664 end
665 return project_file
666 end
667 end

669 function project_deps_get(env::String, name::String)::Union{Nothing,PkgId}
670 project_file = env_project_file(env)
671 if project_file isa String
672 pkg_uuid = explicit_project_deps_get(project_file, name)
673 pkg_uuid === nothing || return PkgId(pkg_uuid, name)
674 elseif project_file
675 return implicit_project_deps_get(env, name)
676 end
677 return nothing
678 end

680 function manifest_deps_get(env::String, where::PkgId, name::String)::Union{Nothing,PkgId}
681 uuid = where.uuid
682 @assert uuid !== nothing
683 project_file = env_project_file(env)
684 if project_file isa String
685 # first check if `where` names the Project itself
686 proj = project_file_name_uuid(project_file, where.name)
687 if proj == where
688 # if `where` matches the project, use [deps] section as manifest, and stop searching
689 pkg_uuid = explicit_project_deps_get(project_file, name)
690 return PkgId(pkg_uuid, name)
691 end
692 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
693 exts = get(d, "extensions", nothing)::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
694 if exts !== nothing
695 # Check if `where` is an extension of the project
696 if where.name in keys(exts) && where.uuid == uuid5(proj.uuid::UUID, where.name)
697 # Extensions can load weak deps...
698 weakdeps = get(d, "weakdeps", nothing)::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
699 if weakdeps !== nothing
700 wuuid = get(weakdeps, name, nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
701 if wuuid !== nothing
702 return PkgId(UUID(wuuid), name)
703 end
704 end
705 # ... and they can load same deps as the project itself
706 mby_uuid = explicit_project_deps_get(project_file, name)
707 mby_uuid === nothing || return PkgId(mby_uuid, name)
708 end
709 end
710 # look for manifest file and `where` stanza
711 return explicit_manifest_deps_get(project_file, where, name)
712 elseif project_file
713 # if env names a directory, search it
714 return implicit_manifest_deps_get(env, where, name)
715 end
716 return nothing
717 end
718
719 function manifest_uuid_path(env::String, pkg::PkgId)::Union{Nothing,String,Missing}
720 project_file = env_project_file(env)
721 if project_file isa String
722 proj = project_file_name_uuid(project_file, pkg.name)
723 if proj == pkg
724 # if `pkg` matches the project, return the project itself
725 return project_file_path(project_file)
726 end
727 mby_ext = project_file_ext_path(project_file, pkg)
728 mby_ext === nothing || return mby_ext
729 # look for manifest file and `where` stanza
730 return explicit_manifest_uuid_path(project_file, pkg)
731 elseif project_file
732 # if env names a directory, search it
733 proj = implicit_manifest_uuid_path(env, pkg)
734 proj === nothing || return proj
735 # if not found
736 triggers = get(EXT_PRIMED, pkg, nothing)
737 if triggers !== nothing
738 parentid = triggers[1]
739 _, parent_project_file = entry_point_and_project_file(env, parentid.name)
740 if parent_project_file !== nothing
741 parentproj = project_file_name_uuid(parent_project_file, parentid.name)
742 if parentproj == parentid
743 mby_ext = project_file_ext_path(parent_project_file, pkg)
744 mby_ext === nothing || return mby_ext
745 end
746 end
747 end
748 end
749 return nothing
750 end
751
752
753 function find_ext_path(project_path::String, extname::String)
754 extfiledir = joinpath(project_path, "ext", extname, extname * ".jl")
755 isfile(extfiledir) && return extfiledir
756 return joinpath(project_path, "ext", extname * ".jl")
757 end
758
759 function project_file_ext_path(project_file::String, ext::PkgId)
760 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
761 p = project_file_path(project_file)
762 exts = get(d, "extensions", nothing)::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
763 if exts !== nothing
764 if ext.name in keys(exts) && ext.uuid == uuid5(UUID(d["uuid"]::String), ext.name)
765 return find_ext_path(p, ext.name)
766 end
767 end
768 return nothing
769 end

771 # find project file's top-level UUID entry (or nothing)
772 function project_file_name_uuid(project_file::String, name::String)::PkgId
773 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
774 uuid′ = get(d, "uuid", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
775 uuid = uuid′ === nothing ? dummy_uuid(project_file) : UUID(uuid′)
776 name = get(d, "name", name)::String
777 return PkgId(uuid, name)
778 end

780 function project_file_path(project_file::String)
781 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
782 joinpath(dirname(project_file), get(d, "path", "")::String)
783 end
784
785 # find project file's corresponding manifest file
786 function project_file_manifest_path(project_file::String)::Union{Nothing,String}
787 @lock require_lock begin
788 cache = LOADING_CACHE[]
789 if cache !== nothing
790 manifest_path = get(cache.project_file_manifest_path, project_file, missing)
791 manifest_path === missing || return manifest_path
792 end
793 dir = abspath(dirname(project_file))
794 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
795 explicit_manifest = get(d, "manifest", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
796 manifest_path = nothing
797 if explicit_manifest !== nothing
798 manifest_file = normpath(joinpath(dir, explicit_manifest))
799 if isfile_casesensitive(manifest_file)
800 manifest_path = manifest_file
801 end
802 end
803 if manifest_path === nothing
804 for mfst in manifest_names
805 manifest_file = joinpath(dir, mfst)
806 if isfile_casesensitive(manifest_file)
807 manifest_path = manifest_file
808 break
809 end
810 end
811 end
812 if cache !== nothing
813 cache.project_file_manifest_path[project_file] = manifest_path
814 end
815 return manifest_path
816 end
817 end

819 # given a directory (implicit env from LOAD_PATH) and a name,
820 # check if it is an implicit package
821 function entry_point_and_project_file_inside(dir::String, name::String)::Union{Tuple{Nothing,Nothing},Tuple{String,Nothing},Tuple{String,String}}
822 path = normpath(joinpath(dir, "src", "$name.jl"))
823 isfile_casesensitive(path) || return nothing, nothing
824 for proj in project_names
825 project_file = normpath(joinpath(dir, proj))
826 isfile_casesensitive(project_file) || continue
827 return path, project_file
828 end
829 return path, nothing
830 end
831
832 # given a project directory (implicit env from LOAD_PATH) and a name,
833 # find an entry point for `name`, and see if it has an associated project file
834 function entry_point_and_project_file(dir::String, name::String)::Union{Tuple{Nothing,Nothing},Tuple{String,Nothing},Tuple{String,String}}
835 path = normpath(joinpath(dir, "$name.jl"))
836 isfile_casesensitive(path) && return path, nothing
837 dir_name = joinpath(dir, name)
838 path, project_file = entry_point_and_project_file_inside(dir_name, name)
839 path === nothing || return path, project_file
840 dir_jl = dir_name * ".jl"
841 path, project_file = entry_point_and_project_file_inside(dir_jl, name)
842 path === nothing || return path, project_file
843 return nothing, nothing
844 end

846 # Find the project file for the extension `ext` in the implicit env `dir``
847 function implicit_env_project_file_extension(dir::String, ext::PkgId)
848 for pkg in readdir(dir; join=true)
849 project_file = env_project_file(pkg)
850 project_file isa String || continue
851 path = project_file_ext_path(project_file, ext)
852 if path !== nothing
853 return path, project_file
854 end
855 end
856 return nothing, nothing
857 end

859 # given a path and a name, return the entry point
860 function entry_path(path::String, name::String)::Union{Nothing,String}
861 isfile_casesensitive(path) && return normpath(path)
862 path = normpath(joinpath(path, "src", "$name.jl"))
863 isfile_casesensitive(path) && return path
864 return nothing # source not found
865 end

867 ## explicit project & manifest API ##
868
869 # find project file root or deps `name => uuid` mapping
870 # `ext` is the name of the extension if `name` is loaded from one
871 # return `nothing` if `name` is not found
872 function explicit_project_deps_get(project_file::String, name::String, ext::Union{String,Nothing}=nothing)::Union{Nothing,UUID}
873 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
874 if get(d, "name", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing} === name
875 root_uuid = dummy_uuid(project_file)
876 uuid = get(d, "uuid", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
877 return uuid === nothing ? root_uuid : UUID(uuid)
878 end
879 deps = get(d, "deps", nothing)::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
880 if deps !== nothing
881 uuid = get(deps, name, nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
882 uuid === nothing || return UUID(uuid)
883 end
884 if ext !== nothing
885 extensions = get(d, "extensions", nothing)
886 extensions === nothing && return nothing
887 ext_data = get(extensions, ext, nothing)
888 ext_data === nothing && return nothing
889 if (ext_data isa String && name == ext_data) || (ext_data isa Vector{String} && name in ext_data)
890 weakdeps = get(d, "weakdeps", nothing)::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
891 weakdeps === nothing && return nothing
892 wuuid = get(weakdeps, name, nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
893 wuuid === nothing && return nothing
894 return UUID(wuuid)
895 end
896 end
897 return nothing
898 end
899
900 function is_v1_format_manifest(raw_manifest::Dict{String})
901 if haskey(raw_manifest, "manifest_format")
902 mf = raw_manifest["manifest_format"]
903 if mf isa Dict{String} && haskey(mf, "uuid")
904 # the off-chance where an old format manifest has a dep called "manifest_format"
905 return true
906 end
907 return false
908 else
909 return true
910 end
911 end
912
913 # returns a deps list for both old and new manifest formats
914 function get_deps(raw_manifest::Dict)
915 if is_v1_format_manifest(raw_manifest)
916 return raw_manifest
917 else
918 # if the manifest has no deps, there won't be a `deps` field
919 return get(Dict{String, Any}, raw_manifest, "deps")::Dict{String, Any}
920 end
921 end
922
923 # find `where` stanza and return the PkgId for `name`
924 # return `nothing` if it did not find `where` (indicating caller should continue searching)
925 function explicit_manifest_deps_get(project_file::String, where::PkgId, name::String)::Union{Nothing,PkgId}
926 manifest_file = project_file_manifest_path(project_file)
927 manifest_file === nothing && return nothing # manifest not found--keep searching LOAD_PATH
928 d = get_deps(parsed_toml(manifest_file))
929 found_where = false
930 found_name = false
931 for (dep_name, entries) in d
932 entries::Vector{Any}
933 for entry in entries
934 entry = entry::Dict{String, Any}
935 uuid = get(entry, "uuid", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
936 uuid === nothing && continue
937 # deps is either a list of names (deps = ["DepA", "DepB"]) or
938 # a table of entries (deps = {"DepA" = "6ea...", "DepB" = "55d..."}
939 deps = get(entry, "deps", nothing)::Union{Vector{String}, Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
940 if UUID(uuid) === where.uuid
941 found_where = true
942 if deps isa Vector{String}
943 found_name = name in deps
944 found_name && @goto done
945 elseif deps isa Dict{String, Any}
946 deps = deps::Dict{String, Any}
947 for (dep, uuid) in deps
948 uuid::String
949 if dep === name
950 return PkgId(UUID(uuid), name)
951 end
952 end
953 end
954 else # Check for extensions
955 extensions = get(entry, "extensions", nothing)
956 if extensions !== nothing
957 if haskey(extensions, where.name) && where.uuid == uuid5(UUID(uuid), where.name)
958 found_where = true
959 if name == dep_name
960 return PkgId(UUID(uuid), name)
961 end
962 exts = extensions[where.name]::Union{String, Vector{String}}
963 weakdeps = get(entry, "weakdeps", nothing)::Union{Vector{String}, Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
964 if (exts isa String && name == exts) || (exts isa Vector{String} && name in exts)
965 for deps′ in [weakdeps, deps]
966 if deps′ !== nothing
967 if deps′ isa Vector{String}
968 found_name = name in deps′
969 found_name && @goto done
970 elseif deps′ isa Dict{String, Any}
971 deps′ = deps′::Dict{String, Any}
972 for (dep, uuid) in deps′
973 uuid::String
974 if dep === name
975 return PkgId(UUID(uuid), name)
976 end
977 end
978 end
979 end
980 end
981 end
982 # `name` is not an ext, do standard lookup as if this was the parent
983 return identify_package(PkgId(UUID(uuid), dep_name), name)
984 end
985 end
986 end
987 end
988 end
989 @label done
990 found_where || return nothing
991 found_name || return PkgId(name)
992 # Only reach here if deps was not a dict which mean we have a unique name for the dep
993 name_deps = get(d, name, nothing)::Union{Nothing, Vector{Any}}
994 if name_deps === nothing || length(name_deps) != 1
995 error("expected a single entry for $(repr(name)) in $(repr(project_file))")
996 end
997 entry = first(name_deps::Vector{Any})::Dict{String, Any}
998 uuid = get(entry, "uuid", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
999 uuid === nothing && return nothing
1000 return PkgId(UUID(uuid), name)
1001 end
1002
1003 # find `uuid` stanza, return the corresponding path
1004 function explicit_manifest_uuid_path(project_file::String, pkg::PkgId)::Union{Nothing,String,Missing}
1005 manifest_file = project_file_manifest_path(project_file)
1006 manifest_file === nothing && return nothing # no manifest, skip env
1007
1008 d = get_deps(parsed_toml(manifest_file))
1009 entries = get(d, pkg.name, nothing)::Union{Nothing, Vector{Any}}
1010 if entries !== nothing
1011 for entry in entries
1012 entry = entry::Dict{String, Any}
1013 uuid = get(entry, "uuid", nothing)::Union{Nothing, String}
1014 uuid === nothing && continue
1015 if UUID(uuid) === pkg.uuid
1016 return explicit_manifest_entry_path(manifest_file, pkg, entry)
1017 end
1018 end
1019 end
1020 # Extensions
1021 for (name, entries) in d
1022 entries = entries::Vector{Any}
1023 for entry in entries
1024 uuid = get(entry, "uuid", nothing)::Union{Nothing, String}
1025 extensions = get(entry, "extensions", nothing)::Union{Nothing, Dict{String, Any}}
1026 if extensions !== nothing && haskey(extensions, pkg.name) && uuid !== nothing && uuid5(UUID(uuid), pkg.name) == pkg.uuid
1027 parent_path = locate_package(PkgId(UUID(uuid), name))
1028 if parent_path === nothing
1029 error("failed to find source of parent package: \"$name\"")
1030 end
1031 p = normpath(dirname(parent_path), "..")
1032 return find_ext_path(p, pkg.name)
1033 end
1034 end
1035 end
1036 return nothing
1037 end
1038
1039 function explicit_manifest_entry_path(manifest_file::String, pkg::PkgId, entry::Dict{String,Any})
1040 path = get(entry, "path", nothing)::Union{Nothing, String}
1041 if path !== nothing
1042 path = normpath(abspath(dirname(manifest_file), path))
1043 return path
1044 end
1045 hash = get(entry, "git-tree-sha1", nothing)::Union{Nothing, String}
1046 if hash === nothing
1047 mbypath = manifest_uuid_path(Sys.STDLIB, pkg)
1048 if mbypath isa String
1049 return entry_path(mbypath, pkg.name)
1050 end
1051 return nothing
1052 end
1053 hash = SHA1(hash)
1054 # Keep the 4 since it used to be the default
1055 uuid = pkg.uuid::UUID # checked within `explicit_manifest_uuid_path`
1056 for slug in (version_slug(uuid, hash), version_slug(uuid, hash, 4))
1057 for depot in DEPOT_PATH
1058 path = joinpath(depot, "packages", pkg.name, slug)
1059 ispath(path) && return abspath(path)
1060 end
1061 end
1062 # no depot contains the package, return missing to stop looking
1063 return missing
1064 end

1066 ## implicit project & manifest API ##
1067
1068 # look for an entry point for `name` from a top-level package (no environment)
1069 # otherwise return `nothing` to indicate the caller should keep searching
1070 function implicit_project_deps_get(dir::String, name::String)::Union{Nothing,PkgId}
1071 path, project_file = entry_point_and_project_file(dir, name)
1072 if project_file === nothing
1073 path === nothing && return nothing
1074 return PkgId(name)
1075 end
1076 proj = project_file_name_uuid(project_file, name)
1077 proj.name == name || return nothing
1078 return proj
1079 end
1080
1081 # look for an entry-point for `name`, check that UUID matches
1082 # if there's a project file, look up `name` in its deps and return that
1083 # otherwise return `nothing` to indicate the caller should keep searching
1084 function implicit_manifest_deps_get(dir::String, where::PkgId, name::String)::Union{Nothing,PkgId}
1085 @assert where.uuid !== nothing
1086 project_file = entry_point_and_project_file(dir, where.name)[2]
1087 if project_file === nothing
1088 # `where` could be an extension
1089 project_file = implicit_env_project_file_extension(dir, where)[2]
1090 project_file === nothing && return nothing
1091 end
1092 proj = project_file_name_uuid(project_file, where.name)
1093 ext = nothing
1094 if proj !== where
1095 # `where` could be an extension in `proj`
1096 d = parsed_toml(project_file)
1097 exts = get(d, "extensions", nothing)::Union{Dict{String, Any}, Nothing}
1098 if exts !== nothing && where.name in keys(exts)
1099 if where.uuid !== uuid5(proj.uuid, where.name)
1100 return nothing
1101 end
1102 ext = where.name
1103 else
1104 return nothing
1105 end
1106 end
1107 # this is the correct project, so stop searching here
1108 pkg_uuid = explicit_project_deps_get(project_file, name, ext)
1109 return PkgId(pkg_uuid, name)
1110 end
1111
1112 # look for an entry-point for `pkg` and return its path if UUID matches
1113 function implicit_manifest_uuid_path(dir::String, pkg::PkgId)::Union{Nothing,String}
1114 path, project_file = entry_point_and_project_file(dir, pkg.name)
1115 if project_file === nothing
1116 pkg.uuid === nothing || return nothing
1117 return path
1118 end
1119 proj = project_file_name_uuid(project_file, pkg.name)
1120 proj == pkg || return nothing
1121 return path
1122 end

1126 function find_source_file(path::AbstractString)
1127 (isabspath(path) || isfile(path)) && return path
1128 base_path = joinpath(Sys.BINDIR, DATAROOTDIR, "julia", "base", path)
1129 return isfile(base_path) ? normpath(base_path) : nothing
1130 end
1131
1132 function cache_file_entry(pkg::PkgId)
1133 uuid = pkg.uuid
1134 return joinpath(
1135 "compiled",
1136 "v$(VERSION.major).$(VERSION.minor)",
1137 uuid === nothing ? "" : pkg.name),
1138 uuid === nothing ? pkg.name : package_slug(uuid)
1139 end
1140
1141 # for use during running the REPL precompilation subprocess script, given we don't
1142 # want it to pick up caches that already exist for other optimization levels
1143 const ignore_compiled_cache = PkgId[]
1144
1145 function find_all_in_cache_path(pkg::PkgId, DEPOT_PATH::typeof(DEPOT_PATH)=DEPOT_PATH)
1146 paths = String[]
1147 pkg in ignore_compiled_cache && return paths
1148 entrypath, entryfile = cache_file_entry(pkg)
1149 for path in DEPOT_PATH
1150 path = joinpath(path, entrypath)
1151 isdir(path) || continue
1152 for file in readdir(path, sort = false) # no sort given we sort later
1153 if !((pkg.uuid === nothing && file == entryfile * ".ji") ||
1154 (pkg.uuid !== nothing && startswith(file, entryfile * "_") &&
1155 endswith(file, ".ji")))
1156 continue
1157 end
1158 filepath = joinpath(path, file)
1159 isfile_casesensitive(filepath) && push!(paths, filepath)
1160 end
1161 end
1162 if length(paths) > 1
1163 function sort_by(path)
1164 # when using pkgimages, consider those cache files first
1165 pkgimage = if JLOptions().use_pkgimages != 0
1166 io = open(path, "r")
1167 try
1168 if iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io))
1169 false
1170 else
1171 _, _, _, _, _, _, _, flags = parse_cache_header(io, path)
1172 CacheFlags(flags).use_pkgimages
1173 end
1174 finally
1175 close(io)
1176 end
1177 else
1178 false
1179 end
1180 (; pkgimage, mtime=mtime(path))
1181 end
1182 function sort_lt(a, b)
1183 if a.pkgimage != b.pkgimage
1184 return a.pkgimage < b.pkgimage
1185 end
1186 return a.mtime < b.mtime
1187 end
1188
1189 # allocating the sort vector is less expensive than using sort!(.. by=sort_by),
1190 # which would call the relatively slow mtime multiple times per path
1191 p = sortperm(sort_by.(paths), lt=sort_lt, rev=true)
1192 return paths[p]
1193 else
1194 return paths
1195 end
1196 end
1197
1198 ocachefile_from_cachefile(cachefile) = string(chopsuffix(cachefile, ".ji"), ".", Libc.Libdl.dlext)
1199 cachefile_from_ocachefile(cachefile) = string(chopsuffix(cachefile, ".$(Libc.Libdl.dlext)"), ".ji")
1200
1201
1202 # use an Int counter so that nested @time_imports calls all remain open
1203 const TIMING_IMPORTS = Threads.Atomic{Int}(0)
1204
1205 # loads a precompile cache file, ignoring stale_cachefile tests
1206 # assuming all depmods are already loaded and everything is valid
1207 # these return either the array of modules loaded from the path / content given
1208 # or an Exception that describes why it couldn't be loaded
1209 # and it reconnects the Base.Docs.META
1210 function _include_from_serialized(pkg::PkgId, path::String, ocachepath::Union{Nothing, String}, depmods::Vector{Any}, ignore_native::Union{Nothing,Bool}=nothing; register::Bool=true)
1211 if isnothing(ignore_native)
1212 if JLOptions().code_coverage == 0 && JLOptions().malloc_log == 0
1213 ignore_native = false
1214 else
1215 io = open(path, "r")
1216 try
1217 iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io)) && return ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $path.")
1218 _, (includes, _, _), _, _, _, _, _, _ = parse_cache_header(io, path)
1219 ignore_native = pkg_tracked(includes)
1220 finally
1221 close(io)
1222 end
1223 end
1224 end
1225 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1226 timing_imports = TIMING_IMPORTS[] > 0
1227 try
1228 if timing_imports
1229 t_before = time_ns()
1230 cumulative_compile_timing(true)
1231 t_comp_before = cumulative_compile_time_ns()
1232 end
1233
1234 for i in eachindex(depmods)
1235 dep = depmods[i]
1236 dep isa Module && continue
1237 _, depkey, depbuild_id = dep::Tuple{String, PkgId, UInt128}
1238 dep = something(maybe_loaded_precompile(depkey, depbuild_id))
1239 @assert PkgId(dep) == depkey && module_build_id(dep) === depbuild_id
1240 depmods[i] = dep
1241 end
1242
1243 if ocachepath !== nothing
1244 @debug "Loading object cache file $ocachepath for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))"
1245 sv = ccall(:jl_restore_package_image_from_file, Any, (Cstring, Any, Cint, Cstring, Cint), ocachepath, depmods, false, pkg.name, ignore_native)
1246 else
1247 @debug "Loading cache file $path for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))"
1248 sv = ccall(:jl_restore_incremental, Any, (Cstring, Any, Cint, Cstring), path, depmods, false, pkg.name)
1249 end
1250 if isa(sv, Exception)
1251 return sv
1252 end
1253
1254 restored = register_restored_modules(sv, pkg, path)
1255
1256 for M in restored
1257 M = M::Module
1258 if parentmodule(M) === M && PkgId(M) == pkg
1259 register && register_root_module(M)
1260 if timing_imports
1261 elapsed_time = time_ns() - t_before
1262 comp_time, recomp_time = cumulative_compile_time_ns() .- t_comp_before
1263 print_time_imports_report(M, elapsed_time, comp_time, recomp_time)
1264 end
1265 return M
1266 end
1267 end
1268 return ErrorException("Required dependency $(repr("text/plain", pkg)) failed to load from a cache file.")
1269
1270 finally
1271 timing_imports && cumulative_compile_timing(false)
1272 end
1273 end
1274
1275 # printing functions for @time_imports
1276 # note that the time inputs are UInt64 on all platforms. Give default values here so that we don't have
1277 # confusing UInt64 types in generate_precompile.jl
1278 function print_time_imports_report(
1279 mod::Module,
1280 elapsed_time::UInt64=UInt64(1),
1281 comp_time::UInt64=UInt64(1),
1282 recomp_time::UInt64=UInt64(1)
1283 )
1284 print(lpad(round(elapsed_time / 1e6, digits=1), 9), " ms ")
1285 ext_parent = extension_parent_name(mod)
1286 if ext_parent !== nothing
1287 print(ext_parent::String, " → ")
1288 end
1289 print(string(mod))
1290 if comp_time > 0
1291 perc = Ryu.writefixed(Float64(100 * comp_time / (elapsed_time)), 2)
1292 printstyled(" $perc% compilation time", color = Base.info_color())
1293 end
1294 if recomp_time > 0
1295 perc = Float64(100 * recomp_time / comp_time)
1296 perc_show = perc < 1 ? "<1" : Ryu.writefixed(perc, 0)
1297 printstyled(" ($perc_show% recompilation)", color = Base.warn_color())
1298 end
1299 println()
1300 end
1301 function print_time_imports_report_init(
1302 mod::Module, i::Int=1,
1303 elapsed_time::UInt64=UInt64(1),
1304 comp_time::UInt64=UInt64(1),
1305 recomp_time::UInt64=UInt64(1)
1306 )
1307 connector = i > 1 ? "├" : "┌"
1308 printstyled(" $connector ", color = :light_black)
1309 print("$(round(elapsed_time / 1e6, digits=1)) ms $mod.__init__() ")
1310 if comp_time > 0
1311 perc = Ryu.writefixed(Float64(100 * (comp_time) / elapsed_time), 2)
1312 printstyled("$perc% compilation time", color = Base.info_color())
1313 end
1314 if recomp_time > 0
1315 perc = Float64(100 * recomp_time / comp_time)
1316 printstyled(" ($(perc < 1 ? "<1" : Ryu.writefixed(perc, 0))% recompilation)", color = Base.warn_color())
1317 end
1318 println()
1319 end

1321 # if M is an extension, return the string name of the parent. Otherwise return nothing
1322 function extension_parent_name(M::Module)
1323 rootmodule = moduleroot(M)
1324 src_path = pathof(rootmodule)
1325 src_path === nothing && return nothing
1326 pkgdir_parts = splitpath(src_path)
1327 ext_pos = findlast(==("ext"), pkgdir_parts)
1328 if ext_pos !== nothing && ext_pos >= length(pkgdir_parts) - 2
1329 parent_package_root = joinpath(pkgdir_parts[1:ext_pos-1]...)
1330 parent_package_project_file = locate_project_file(parent_package_root)
1331 if parent_package_project_file isa String
1332 d = parsed_toml(parent_package_project_file)
1333 name = get(d, "name", nothing)
1334 if name !== nothing
1335 return name
1336 end
1337 end
1338 end
1339 return nothing
1340 end
1341
1342 function register_restored_modules(sv::SimpleVector, pkg::PkgId, path::String)
1343 # This function is also used by PkgCacheInspector.jl
1344 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1345 restored = sv[1]::Vector{Any}
1346 for M in restored
1347 M = M::Module
1348 if isdefined(M, Base.Docs.META) && getfield(M, Base.Docs.META) !== nothing
1349 push!(Base.Docs.modules, M)
1350 end
1351 if parentmodule(M) === M
1352 push!(loaded_modules_order, M)
1353 push!(get!(Vector{Module}, loaded_precompiles, pkg), M)
1354 end
1355 end
1356
1357 # Register this cache path now - If Requires.jl is loaded, Revise may end
1358 # up looking at the cache path during the init callback.
1359 get!(PkgOrigin, pkgorigins, pkg).cachepath = path
1360
1361 inits = sv[2]::Vector{Any}
1362 if !isempty(inits)
1363 unlock(require_lock) # temporarily _unlock_ during these callbacks
1364 try
1365 for (i, mod) in pairs(inits)
1366 run_module_init(mod, i)
1367 end
1368 finally
1369 lock(require_lock)
1370 end
1371 end
1372 return restored
1373 end
1374
1375 function run_module_init(mod::Module, i::Int=1)
1376 # `i` informs ordering for the `@time_imports` report formatting
1377 if TIMING_IMPORTS[] == 0
1378 ccall(:jl_init_restored_module, Cvoid, (Any,), mod)
1379 elseif isdefined(mod, :__init__)
1380 elapsed_time = time_ns()
1381 cumulative_compile_timing(true)
1382 compile_elapsedtimes = cumulative_compile_time_ns()
1383
1384 ccall(:jl_init_restored_module, Cvoid, (Any,), mod)
1385
1386 elapsed_time = time_ns() - elapsed_time
1387 cumulative_compile_timing(false);
1388 comp_time, recomp_time = cumulative_compile_time_ns() .- compile_elapsedtimes
1389
1390 print_time_imports_report_init(mod, i, elapsed_time, comp_time, recomp_time)
1391 end
1392 end

1394 function run_package_callbacks(modkey::PkgId)
1395 (modkey == precompilation_target) && return nothing
1396 run_extension_callbacks(modkey)
1397 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1398 unlock(require_lock)
1399 try
1400 for callback in package_callbacks
1401 invokelatest(callback, modkey)
1402 end
1403 catch
1404 # Try to continue loading if a callback errors
1405 errs = current_exceptions()
1406 @error "Error during package callback" exception=errs
1407 finally
1408 lock(require_lock)
1409 end
1410 nothing
1411 end

1418 mutable struct ExtensionId
1419 const id::PkgId
1420 const parentid::PkgId # just need the name, for printing
1421 const n_total_triggers::Int
1422 ntriggers::Int # how many more packages must be defined until this is loaded
1423 end
1424
1425 const EXT_PRIMED = Dict{PkgId,Vector{PkgId}}() # Extension -> Parent + Triggers (parent is always first)
1426 const EXT_DORMITORY = Dict{PkgId,Vector{ExtensionId}}() # Trigger -> Extensions that can be triggered by it
1427 const EXT_DORMITORY_FAILED = ExtensionId[]
1428
1429 function insert_extension_triggers(pkg::PkgId)
1430 pkg.uuid === nothing && return
1431 path_env_loc = locate_package_env(pkg)
1432 path_env_loc === nothing && return
1433 path, env_loc = path_env_loc
1434 insert_extension_triggers(env_loc, pkg)
1435 end
1436
1437 function insert_extension_triggers(env::String, pkg::PkgId)::Union{Nothing,Missing}
1438 project_file = env_project_file(env)
1439 if project_file isa String || project_file
1440 implicit_project_file = project_file
1441 if !(implicit_project_file isa String)
1442 # if env names a directory, search it for an implicit project file (for stdlibs)
1443 path, implicit_project_file = entry_point_and_project_file(env, pkg.name)
1444 if !(implicit_project_file isa String)
1445 return nothing
1446 end
1447 end
1448 # Look in project for extensions to insert
1449 proj_pkg = project_file_name_uuid(implicit_project_file, pkg.name)
1450 if pkg == proj_pkg
1451 d_proj = parsed_toml(implicit_project_file)
1452 extensions = get(d_proj, "extensions", nothing)::Union{Nothing, Dict{String, Any}}
1453 extensions === nothing && return
1454 weakdeps = get(Dict{String, Any}, d_proj, "weakdeps")::Dict{String,Any}
1455 deps = get(Dict{String, Any}, d_proj, "deps")::Dict{String,Any}
1456 total_deps = merge(weakdeps, deps)
1457 return _insert_extension_triggers(pkg, extensions, total_deps)
1458 end
1459
1460 # Now look in manifest
1461 project_file isa String || return nothing
1462 manifest_file = project_file_manifest_path(project_file)
1463 manifest_file === nothing && return
1464 d = get_deps(parsed_toml(manifest_file))
1465 for (dep_name, entries) in d
1466 entries::Vector{Any}
1467 for entry in entries
1468 entry = entry::Dict{String, Any}
1469 uuid = get(entry, "uuid", nothing)::Union{String, Nothing}
1470 uuid === nothing && continue
1471 if UUID(uuid) == pkg.uuid
1472 extensions = get(entry, "extensions", nothing)::Union{Nothing, Dict{String, Any}}
1473 extensions === nothing && return
1474 weakdeps = get(Dict{String, Any}, entry, "weakdeps")::Union{Vector{String}, Dict{String,Any}}
1475 deps = get(Dict{String, Any}, entry, "deps")::Union{Vector{String}, Dict{String,Any}}
1476
1477 function expand_deps_list(deps′::Vector{String})
1478 deps′_expanded = Dict{String, Any}()
1479 for (dep_name, entries) in d
1480 dep_name in deps′ || continue
1481 entries::Vector{Any}
1482 if length(entries) != 1
1483 error("expected a single entry for $(repr(dep_name)) in $(repr(project_file))")
1484 end
1485 entry = first(entries)::Dict{String, Any}
1486 uuid = entry["uuid"]::String
1487 deps′_expanded[dep_name] = uuid
1488 end
1489 return deps′_expanded
1490 end
1491
1492 if weakdeps isa Vector{String}
1493 weakdeps = expand_deps_list(weakdeps)
1494 end
1495 if deps isa Vector{String}
1496 deps = expand_deps_list(deps)
1497 end
1498
1499 total_deps = merge(weakdeps, deps)
1500 return _insert_extension_triggers(pkg, extensions, total_deps)
1501 end
1502 end
1503 end
1504 end
1505 return nothing
1506 end
1507
1508 function _insert_extension_triggers(parent::PkgId, extensions::Dict{String, Any}, totaldeps::Dict{String, Any})
1509 for (ext, triggers) in extensions
1510 triggers = triggers::Union{String, Vector{String}}
1511 triggers isa String && (triggers = [triggers])
1512 id = PkgId(uuid5(parent.uuid::UUID, ext), ext)
1513 if haskey(EXT_PRIMED, id) || haskey(Base.loaded_modules, id)
1514 continue # extension is already primed or loaded, don't add it again
1515 end
1516 EXT_PRIMED[id] = trigger_ids = PkgId[parent]
1517 gid = ExtensionId(id, parent, 1 + length(triggers), 1 + length(triggers))
1518 trigger1 = get!(Vector{ExtensionId}, EXT_DORMITORY, parent)
1519 push!(trigger1, gid)
1520 for trigger in triggers
1521 # TODO: Better error message if this lookup fails?
1522 uuid_trigger = UUID(totaldeps[trigger]::String)
1523 trigger_id = PkgId(uuid_trigger, trigger)
1524 push!(trigger_ids, trigger_id)
1525 if !haskey(Base.loaded_modules, trigger_id) || haskey(package_locks, trigger_id) || (trigger_id == precompilation_target)
1526 trigger1 = get!(Vector{ExtensionId}, EXT_DORMITORY, trigger_id)
1527 push!(trigger1, gid)
1528 else
1529 gid.ntriggers -= 1
1530 end
1531 end
1532 end
1533 end
1534
1535 loading_extension::Bool = false
1536 loadable_extensions::Union{Nothing,Vector{PkgId}} = nothing
1537 precompiling_extension::Bool = false
1538 precompilation_target::Union{Nothing,PkgId} = nothing
1539 function run_extension_callbacks(extid::ExtensionId)
1540 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1541 succeeded = try
1542 # Used by Distributed to now load extensions in the package callback
1543 global loading_extension = true
1544 _require_prelocked(extid.id)
1545 @debug "Extension $(extid.id.name) of $(extid.parentid.name) loaded"
1546 true
1547 catch
1548 # Try to continue loading if loading an extension errors
1549 errs = current_exceptions()
1550 @error "Error during loading of extension $(extid.id.name) of $(extid.parentid.name), \
1551 use `Base.retry_load_extensions()` to retry." exception=errs
1552 false
1553 finally
1554 global loading_extension = false
1555 end
1556 return succeeded
1557 end
1558
1559 function run_extension_callbacks(pkgid::PkgId)
1560 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1561 # take ownership of extids that depend on this pkgid
1562 extids = pop!(EXT_DORMITORY, pkgid, nothing)
1563 extids === nothing && return
1564 extids_to_load = Vector{ExtensionId}()
1565 for extid in extids
1566 @assert extid.ntriggers > 0
1567 extid.ntriggers -= 1
1568 if extid.ntriggers == 0 && (loadable_extensions === nothing || extid.id in loadable_extensions)
1569 push!(extids_to_load, extid)
1570 end
1571 end
1572 # Load extensions with the fewest triggers first
1573 sort!(extids_to_load, by=extid->extid.n_total_triggers)
1574 for extid in extids_to_load
1575 # actually load extid, now that all dependencies are met,
1576 succeeded = run_extension_callbacks(extid)
1577 succeeded || push!(EXT_DORMITORY_FAILED, extid)
1578 end
1579
1580 return
1581 end
1582
1583 """
1584 retry_load_extensions()
1585
1586 Loads all the (not yet loaded) extensions that have their extension-dependencies loaded.
1587 This is used in cases where the automatic loading of an extension failed
1588 due to some problem with the extension. Instead of restarting the Julia session,
1589 the extension can be fixed, and this function run.
1590 """
1591 function retry_load_extensions()
1592 @lock require_lock begin
1593 # this copy is desired since run_extension_callbacks will release this lock
1594 # so this can still mutate the list to drop successful ones
1595 failed = copy(EXT_DORMITORY_FAILED)
1596 empty!(EXT_DORMITORY_FAILED)
1597 filter!(failed) do extid
1598 return !run_extension_callbacks(extid)
1599 end
1600 prepend!(EXT_DORMITORY_FAILED, failed)
1601 end
1602 return
1603 end
1604
1605 """
1606 get_extension(parent::Module, extension::Symbol)
1607
1608 Return the module for `extension` of `parent` or return `nothing` if the extension is not loaded.
1609 """
1610 get_extension(parent::Module, ext::Symbol) = get_extension(PkgId(parent), ext)
1611 function get_extension(parentid::PkgId, ext::Symbol)
1612 parentid.uuid === nothing && return nothing
1613 extid = PkgId(uuid5(parentid.uuid, string(ext)), string(ext))
1614 return get(loaded_modules, extid, nothing)
1615 end
1616

1620 struct CacheFlags
1621 # OOICCDDP - see jl_cache_flags
1622 use_pkgimages::Bool
1623 debug_level::Int
1624 check_bounds::Int
1625 inline::Bool
1626 opt_level::Int
1627 end
1628 function CacheFlags(f::UInt8)
1629 use_pkgimages = Bool(f & 1)
1630 debug_level = Int((f >> 1) & 3)
1631 check_bounds = Int((f >> 3) & 3)
1632 inline = Bool((f >> 5) & 1)
1633 opt_level = Int((f >> 6) & 3) # define OPT_LEVEL in statiddata_utils
1634 CacheFlags(use_pkgimages, debug_level, check_bounds, inline, opt_level)
1635 end
1636 CacheFlags(f::Int) = CacheFlags(UInt8(f))
1637 function CacheFlags(cf::CacheFlags=CacheFlags(ccall(:jl_cache_flags, UInt8, ()));
1638 use_pkgimages::Union{Nothing,Bool}=nothing,
1639 debug_level::Union{Nothing,Int}=nothing,
1640 check_bounds::Union{Nothing,Int}=nothing,
1641 inline::Union{Nothing,Bool}=nothing,
1642 opt_level::Union{Nothing,Int}=nothing
1643 )
1644 return CacheFlags(
1645 use_pkgimages === nothing ? cf.use_pkgimages : use_pkgimages,
1646 debug_level === nothing ? cf.debug_level : debug_level,
1647 check_bounds === nothing ? cf.check_bounds : check_bounds,
1648 inline === nothing ? cf.inline : inline,
1649 opt_level === nothing ? cf.opt_level : opt_level
1650 )
1651 end
1652 # reflecting jloptions.c defaults
1653 const DefaultCacheFlags = CacheFlags(use_pkgimages=true, debug_level=isdebugbuild() ? 2 : 1, check_bounds=0, inline=true, opt_level=2)
1654
1655 function _cacheflag_to_uint8(cf::CacheFlags)::UInt8
1656 f = UInt8(0)
1657 f |= cf.use_pkgimages << 0
1658 f |= cf.debug_level << 1
1659 f |= cf.check_bounds << 3
1660 f |= cf.inline << 5
1661 f |= cf.opt_level << 6
1662 return f
1663 end
1664
1665 function translate_cache_flags(cacheflags::CacheFlags, defaultflags::CacheFlags)
1666 opts = String[]
1667 cacheflags.use_pkgimages != defaultflags.use_pkgimages && push!(opts, cacheflags.use_pkgimages ? "--pkgimages=yes" : "--pkgimages=no")
1668 cacheflags.debug_level != defaultflags.debug_level && push!(opts, "-g$(cacheflags.debug_level)")
1669 cacheflags.check_bounds != defaultflags.check_bounds && push!(opts, ("--check-bounds=auto", "--check-bounds=yes", "--check-bounds=no")[cacheflags.check_bounds + 1])
1670 cacheflags.inline != defaultflags.inline && push!(opts, cacheflags.inline ? "--inline=yes" : "--inline=no")
1671 cacheflags.opt_level != defaultflags.opt_level && push!(opts, "-O$(cacheflags.opt_level)")
1672 return opts
1673 end
1674
1675 function show(io::IO, cf::CacheFlags)
1676 print(io, "CacheFlags(")
1677 print(io, "; use_pkgimages=")
1678 print(io, cf.use_pkgimages)
1679 print(io, ", debug_level=")
1680 print(io, cf.debug_level)
1681 print(io, ", check_bounds=")
1682 print(io, cf.check_bounds)
1683 print(io, ", inline=")
1684 print(io, cf.inline)
1685 print(io, ", opt_level=")
1686 print(io, cf.opt_level)
1687 print(io, ")")
1688 end

1698 function parse_image_target(io::IO)
1699 flags = read(io, Int32)

1702 feature_dis = read(io, 4*nfeature)

1714 for i in 1:ntargets
1715 targets[i] = parse_image_target(io)
1716 end
1717 return targets

1725 struct FeatureName

1728 llvmver::UInt32 # 0 if it is available on the oldest LLVM version we support
1729 end
1730
1731 function feature_names()
1732 fnames = Ref{Ptr{FeatureName}}()
1733 nf = Ref{Csize_t}()
1734 @ccall jl_reflect_feature_names(fnames::Ptr{Ptr{FeatureName}}, nf::Ptr{Csize_t})::Cvoid
1735 if fnames[] == C_NULL
1736 @assert nf[] == 0
1737 return Vector{FeatureName}(undef, 0)

1742 function test_feature(features::Vector{UInt8}, feat::FeatureName)
1743 bitidx = feat.bit
1744 u8idx = div(bitidx, 8) + 1
1745 bit = bitidx % 8
1746 return (features[u8idx] & (1 << bit)) != 0
1747 end

1757 for feat in feature_names()
1758 if test_feature(it.features_en, feat)
1759 name = Base.unsafe_string(feat.name)
1760 if first
1761 first = false
1762 print(io, name)

1764 print(io, ", ", name)

1767 end
1768 print(io, ")")

1770 end
