1772 # should sync with the types of arguments of `stale_cachefile`
1773 const StaleCacheKey = Tuple{Base.PkgId, UInt128, String, String}
1774
1775 function compilecache_path(pkg::PkgId;
1776 ignore_loaded::Bool=false,
1777 stale_cache::Dict{StaleCacheKey,Bool}=Dict{StaleCacheKey, Bool}(),
1778 cachepath_cache::Dict{PkgId, Vector{String}}=Dict{PkgId, Vector{String}}(),
1779 cachepaths::Vector{String}=get!(() -> find_all_in_cache_path(pkg), cachepath_cache, pkg),
1780 sourcepath::Union{String,Nothing}=Base.locate_package(pkg),
1781 flags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags())
1782 path = nothing
1783 isnothing(sourcepath) && error("Cannot locate source for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))")
1784 for path_to_try in cachepaths
1785 staledeps = stale_cachefile(sourcepath, path_to_try; ignore_loaded, requested_flags=flags)
1786 if staledeps === true
1787 continue
1788 end
1789 staledeps, _, _ = staledeps::Tuple{Vector{Any}, Union{Nothing, String}, UInt128}
1790 # finish checking staledeps module graph
1791 for dep in staledeps
1792 dep isa Module && continue
1793 modpath, modkey, modbuild_id = dep::Tuple{String, PkgId, UInt128}
1794 modpaths = get!(() -> find_all_in_cache_path(modkey), cachepath_cache, modkey)
1795 for modpath_to_try in modpaths::Vector{String}
1796 stale_cache_key = (modkey, modbuild_id, modpath, modpath_to_try)::StaleCacheKey
1797 if get!(() -> stale_cachefile(stale_cache_key...; ignore_loaded, requested_flags=flags) === true,
1798 stale_cache, stale_cache_key)
1799 continue
1800 end
1801 @goto check_next_dep
1802 end
1803 @goto check_next_path
1804 @label check_next_dep
1805 end
1806 try
1807 # update timestamp of precompilation file so that it is the first to be tried by code loading
1808 touch(path_to_try)
1809 catch ex
1810 # file might be read-only and then we fail to update timestamp, which is fine
1811 ex isa IOError || rethrow()
1812 end
1813 path = path_to_try
1814 break
1815 @label check_next_path
1816 end
1817 return path
1818 end
1819
1820 """
1821 Base.isprecompiled(pkg::PkgId; ignore_loaded::Bool=false)
1822
1823 Returns whether a given PkgId within the active project is precompiled.
1824
1825 By default this check observes the same approach that code loading takes
1826 with respect to when different versions of dependencies are currently loaded
1827 to that which is expected. To ignore loaded modules and answer as if in a
1828 fresh julia session specify `ignore_loaded=true`.
1829
1830 !!! compat "Julia 1.10"
1831 This function requires at least Julia 1.10.
1832 """
1833 function isprecompiled(pkg::PkgId;
1834 ignore_loaded::Bool=false,
1835 stale_cache::Dict{StaleCacheKey,Bool}=Dict{StaleCacheKey, Bool}(),
1836 cachepath_cache::Dict{PkgId, Vector{String}}=Dict{PkgId, Vector{String}}(),
1837 cachepaths::Vector{String}=get!(() -> find_all_in_cache_path(pkg), cachepath_cache, pkg),
1838 sourcepath::Union{String,Nothing}=Base.locate_package(pkg),
1839 flags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags())
1840 path = compilecache_path(pkg; ignore_loaded, stale_cache, cachepath_cache, cachepaths, sourcepath, flags)
1841 return !isnothing(path)
1842 end
1843
1844 """
1845 Base.isrelocatable(pkg::PkgId)
1846
1847 Returns whether a given PkgId within the active project is precompiled and the
1848 associated cache is relocatable.
1849
1850 !!! compat "Julia 1.11"
1851 This function requires at least Julia 1.11.
1852 """
1853 function isrelocatable(pkg::PkgId)
1854 path = compilecache_path(pkg)
1855 isnothing(path) && return false
1856 io = open(path, "r")
1857 try
1858 iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io)) && throw(ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $cachefile."))
1859 _, (includes, includes_srcfiles, _), _... = _parse_cache_header(io, path)
1860 for inc in includes
1861 !startswith(inc.filename, "@depot") && return false
1862 if inc ∉ includes_srcfiles
1863 # its an include_dependency
1864 track_content = inc.mtime == -1.0
1865 track_content || return false
1866 end
1867 end
1868 finally
1869 close(io)
1870 end
1871 return true
1872 end
1873
1874 # search for a precompile cache file to load, after some various checks
1875 function _tryrequire_from_serialized(modkey::PkgId, build_id::UInt128)
1876 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1877 loaded = start_loading(modkey, build_id, false)
1878 if loaded === nothing
1879 try
1880 modpath = locate_package(modkey)
1881 isnothing(modpath) && error("Cannot locate source for $(repr("text/plain", modkey))")
1882 modpath = String(modpath)::String
1883 set_pkgorigin_version_path(modkey, modpath)
1884 loaded = _require_search_from_serialized(modkey, modpath, build_id, true)
1885 finally
1886 end_loading(modkey, loaded)
1887 end
1888 if loaded isa Module
1889 insert_extension_triggers(modkey)
1890 run_package_callbacks(modkey)
1891 end
1892 end
1893 if loaded isa Module && PkgId(loaded) == modkey && module_build_id(loaded) === build_id
1894 return loaded
1895 end
1896 return ErrorException("Required dependency $modkey failed to load from a cache file.")
1897 end
1898
1899 # returns whether the package is tracked in coverage or malloc tracking based on
1900 # JLOptions and includes
1901 function pkg_tracked(includes)
1902 if JLOptions().code_coverage == 0 && JLOptions().malloc_log == 0
1903 return false
1904 elseif JLOptions().code_coverage == 1 || JLOptions().malloc_log == 1 # user
1905 # Just say true. Pkgimages aren't in Base
1906 return true
1907 elseif JLOptions().code_coverage == 2 || JLOptions().malloc_log == 2 # all
1908 return true
1909 elseif JLOptions().code_coverage == 3 || JLOptions().malloc_log == 3 # tracked path
1910 if JLOptions().tracked_path == C_NULL
1911 return false
1912 else
1913 tracked_path = unsafe_string(JLOptions().tracked_path)
1914 if isempty(tracked_path)
1915 return false
1916 else
1917 return any(includes) do inc
1918 startswith(inc.filename, tracked_path)
1919 end
1920 end
1921 end
1922 end
1923 end
1924
1925 # loads a precompile cache file, ignoring stale_cachefile tests
1926 # load all dependent modules first
1927 function _tryrequire_from_serialized(pkg::PkgId, path::String, ocachepath::Union{Nothing, String})
1928 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1929 local depmodnames
1930 io = open(path, "r")
1931 ignore_native = false
1932 try
1933 iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io)) && return ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $path.")
1934 _, (includes, _, _), depmodnames, _, _, _, clone_targets, _ = parse_cache_header(io, path)
1935
1936 ignore_native = pkg_tracked(includes)
1937
1938 pkgimage = !isempty(clone_targets)
1939 if pkgimage
1940 ocachepath !== nothing || return ArgumentError("Expected ocachepath to be provided")
1941 isfile(ocachepath) || return ArgumentError("Ocachepath $ocachepath is not a file.")
1942 ocachepath == ocachefile_from_cachefile(path) || return ArgumentError("$ocachepath is not the expected ocachefile")
1943 # TODO: Check for valid clone_targets?
1944 isvalid_pkgimage_crc(io, ocachepath) || return ArgumentError("Invalid checksum in cache file $ocachepath.")
1945 else
1946 @assert ocachepath === nothing
1947 end
1948 isvalid_file_crc(io) || return ArgumentError("Invalid checksum in cache file $path.")
1949 finally
1950 close(io)
1951 end
1952 ndeps = length(depmodnames)
1953 depmods = Vector{Any}(undef, ndeps)
1954 for i in 1:ndeps
1955 modkey, build_id = depmodnames[i]
1956 dep = _tryrequire_from_serialized(modkey, build_id)
1957 if !isa(dep, Module)
1958 return dep
1959 end
1960 depmods[i] = dep
1961 end
1962 # then load the file
1963 loaded = _include_from_serialized(pkg, path, ocachepath, depmods, ignore_native; register = true)
1964 return loaded
1965 end
1966
1967 # returns `nothing` if require found a precompile cache for this sourcepath, but couldn't load it or it was stale
1968 # returns the set of modules restored if the cache load succeeded
1969 @constprop :none function _require_search_from_serialized(pkg::PkgId, sourcepath::String, build_id::UInt128, stalecheck::Bool; reasons=nothing, DEPOT_PATH::typeof(DEPOT_PATH)=DEPOT_PATH)
1970 assert_havelock(require_lock)
1971 paths = find_all_in_cache_path(pkg, DEPOT_PATH)
1972 newdeps = PkgId[]
1973 try_build_ids = UInt128[build_id]
1974 if build_id == UInt128(0)
1975 let loaded = get(loaded_precompiles, pkg, nothing)
1976 if loaded !== nothing
1977 for mod in loaded # try these in reverse original load order to see if one is already valid
1978 pushfirst!(try_build_ids, module_build_id(mod))
1979 end
1980 end
1981 end
1982 end
1983 for build_id in try_build_ids
1984 for path_to_try in paths::Vector{String}
1985 staledeps = stale_cachefile(pkg, build_id, sourcepath, path_to_try; reasons, stalecheck)
1986 if staledeps === true
1987 continue
1988 end
1989 try
1990 staledeps, ocachefile, newbuild_id = staledeps::Tuple{Vector{Any}, Union{Nothing, String}, UInt128}
1991 # finish checking staledeps module graph
1992 for i in eachindex(staledeps)
1993 dep = staledeps[i]
1994 dep isa Module && continue
1995 modpath, modkey, modbuild_id = dep::Tuple{String, PkgId, UInt128}
1996 modpaths = find_all_in_cache_path(modkey, DEPOT_PATH)
1997 for modpath_to_try in modpaths
1998 modstaledeps = stale_cachefile(modkey, modbuild_id, modpath, modpath_to_try; stalecheck)
1999 if modstaledeps === true
2000 continue
2001 end
2002 modstaledeps, modocachepath, _ = modstaledeps::Tuple{Vector{Any}, Union{Nothing, String}, UInt128}
2003 staledeps[i] = (modpath, modkey, modbuild_id, modpath_to_try, modstaledeps, modocachepath)
2004 @goto check_next_dep
2005 end
2006 @debug "Rejecting cache file $path_to_try because required dependency $modkey with build ID $(UUID(modbuild_id)) is missing from the cache."
2007 @goto check_next_path
2008 @label check_next_dep
2009 end
2010 M = maybe_loaded_precompile(pkg, newbuild_id)
2011 if isa(M, Module)
2012 stalecheck && register_root_module(M)
2013 return M
2014 end
2015 if stalecheck
2016 try
2017 touch(path_to_try) # update timestamp of precompilation file
2018 catch ex # file might be read-only and then we fail to update timestamp, which is fine
2019 ex isa IOError || rethrow()
2020 end
2021 end
2022 # finish loading module graph into staledeps
2023 # TODO: call all start_loading calls (in reverse order) before calling any _include_from_serialized, since start_loading will drop the loading lock
2024 for i in eachindex(staledeps)
2025 dep = staledeps[i]
2026 dep isa Module && continue
2027 modpath, modkey, modbuild_id, modcachepath, modstaledeps, modocachepath = dep::Tuple{String, PkgId, UInt128, String, Vector{Any}, Union{Nothing, String}}
2028 dep = start_loading(modkey, modbuild_id, stalecheck)
2029 while true
2030 if dep isa Module
2031 if PkgId(dep) == modkey && module_build_id(dep) === modbuild_id
2032 break
2033 else
2034 @debug "Rejecting cache file $path_to_try because module $modkey got loaded at a different version than expected."
2035 @goto check_next_path
2036 end
2037 end
2038 if dep === nothing
2039 try
2040 set_pkgorigin_version_path(modkey, modpath)
2041 dep = _include_from_serialized(modkey, modcachepath, modocachepath, modstaledeps; register = stalecheck)
2042 finally
2043 end_loading(modkey, dep)
2044 end
2045 if !isa(dep, Module)
2046 @debug "Rejecting cache file $path_to_try because required dependency $modkey failed to load from cache file for $modcachepath." exception=dep
2047 @goto check_next_path
2048 else
2049 push!(newdeps, modkey)
2050 end
2051 end
2052 end
2053 staledeps[i] = dep
2054 end
2055 restored = maybe_loaded_precompile(pkg, newbuild_id)
2056 if !isa(restored, Module)
2057 restored = _include_from_serialized(pkg, path_to_try, ocachefile, staledeps; register = stalecheck)
2058 end
2059 isa(restored, Module) && return restored
2060 @debug "Deserialization checks failed while attempting to load cache from $path_to_try" exception=restored
2061 @label check_next_path
2062 finally
2063 for modkey in newdeps
2064 insert_extension_triggers(modkey)
2065 stalecheck && run_package_callbacks(modkey)
2066 end
2067 empty!(newdeps)
2068 end
2069 end
2070 end
2071 return nothing
2072 end
2073
2074 # to synchronize multiple tasks trying to import/using something
2075 const package_locks = Dict{PkgId,Pair{Task,Threads.Condition}}()
2076
2077 debug_loading_deadlocks::Bool = true # Enable a slightly more expensive, but more complete algorithm that can handle simultaneous tasks.
2078 # This only triggers if you have multiple tasks trying to load the same package at the same time,
2079 # so it is unlikely to make a performance difference normally.
2080 function start_loading(modkey::PkgId, build_id::UInt128, stalecheck::Bool)
2081 # handle recursive and concurrent calls to require
2082 assert_havelock(require_lock)
2083 require_lock.reentrancy_cnt == 1 || throw(ConcurrencyViolationError("recursive call to start_loading"))
2084 while true
2085 loaded = stalecheck ? maybe_root_module(modkey) : nothing
2086 loaded isa Module && return loaded
2087 if build_id != UInt128(0)
2088 loaded = maybe_loaded_precompile(modkey, build_id)
2089 loaded isa Module && return loaded
2090 end
2091 loading = get(package_locks, modkey, nothing)
2092 if loading === nothing
2093 package_locks[modkey] = current_task() => Threads.Condition(require_lock)
2094 return nothing
2095 end
2096 # load already in progress for this module on the task
2097 task, cond = loading
2098 deps = String[modkey.name]
2099 pkgid = modkey
2100 assert_havelock(cond.lock)
2101 if debug_loading_deadlocks && current_task() !== task
2102 waiters = Dict{Task,Pair{Task,PkgId}}() # invert to track waiting tasks => loading tasks
2103 for each in package_locks
2104 cond2 = each[2][2]
2105 assert_havelock(cond2.lock)
2106 for waiting in cond2.waitq
2107 push!(waiters, waiting => (each[2][1] => each[1]))
2108 end
2109 end
2110 while true
2111 running = get(waiters, task, nothing)
2112 running === nothing && break
2113 task, pkgid = running
2114 push!(deps, pkgid.name)
2115 task === current_task() && break
2116 end
2117 end
2118 if current_task() === task
2119 others = String[modkey.name] # repeat this to emphasize the cycle here
2120 for each in package_locks # list the rest of the packages being loaded too
2121 if each[2][1] === task
2122 other = each[1].name
2123 other == modkey.name || other == pkgid.name || push!(others, other)
2124 end
2125 end
2126 msg = sprint(deps, others) do io, deps, others
2127 print(io, "deadlock detected in loading ")
2128 join(io, deps, " -> ")
2129 print(io, " -> ")
2130 join(io, others, " && ")
2131 end
2132 throw(ConcurrencyViolationError(msg))
2133 end
2134 loaded = wait(cond)
2135 loaded isa Module && return loaded
2136 end
2137 end
2138
2139 function end_loading(modkey::PkgId, @nospecialize loaded)
2140 loading = pop!(package_locks, modkey)
2141 notify(loading[2], loaded, all=true)
2142 nothing
2143 end
2144
2145 # to notify downstream consumers that a module was successfully loaded
2146 # Callbacks take the form (mod::Base.PkgId) -> nothing.
2147 # WARNING: This is an experimental feature and might change later, without deprecation.
2148 const package_callbacks = Any[]
2149 # to notify downstream consumers that a file has been included into a particular module
2150 # Callbacks take the form (mod::Module, filename::String) -> nothing
2151 # WARNING: This is an experimental feature and might change later, without deprecation.
2152 const include_callbacks = Any[]
2153
2154 # used to optionally track dependencies when requiring a module:
2155 const _concrete_dependencies = Pair{PkgId,UInt128}[] # these dependency versions are "set in stone", because they are explicitly loaded, and the process should try to avoid invalidating them
2156 const _require_dependencies = Any[] # a list of (mod, abspath, fsize, hash, mtime) tuples that are the file dependencies of the module currently being precompiled
2157 const _track_dependencies = Ref(false) # set this to true to track the list of file dependencies
2158 function _include_dependency(mod::Module, _path::AbstractString; track_content=true,
2159 path_may_be_dir=false)
2160 prev = source_path(nothing)
2161 if prev === nothing
2162 path = abspath(_path)
2163 else
2164 path = normpath(joinpath(dirname(prev), _path))
2165 end
2166 if !_track_dependencies[]
2167 if !path_may_be_dir && !isfile(path)
2168 throw(SystemError("opening file $(repr(path))", Libc.ENOENT))
2169 elseif path_may_be_dir && !Filesystem.isreadable(path)
2170 throw(SystemError("opening file or folder $(repr(path))", Libc.ENOENT))
2171 end
2172 else
2173 @lock require_lock begin
2174 if track_content
2175 hash = isdir(path) ? _crc32c(join(readdir(path))) : open(_crc32c, path, "r")
2176 # use mtime=-1.0 here so that fsize==0 && mtime==0.0 corresponds to a missing include_dependency
2177 push!(_require_dependencies, (mod, path, filesize(path), hash, -1.0))
2178 else
2179 push!(_require_dependencies, (mod, path, UInt64(0), UInt32(0), mtime(path)))
2180 end
2181 end
2182 end
2183 return path, prev
2184 end
2185
2186 """
2187 include_dependency(path::AbstractString; track_content::Bool=true)
2188
2189 In a module, declare that the file, directory, or symbolic link specified by `path`
2190 (relative or absolute) is a dependency for precompilation; that is, if `track_content=true`
2191 the module will need to be recompiled if the content of `path` changes
2192 (if `path` is a directory the content equals `join(readdir(path))`).
2193 If `track_content=false` recompilation is triggered when the modification time `mtime` of `path` changes.
2194
2195 This is only needed if your module depends on a path that is not used via [`include`](@ref). It has
2196 no effect outside of compilation.
2197
2198 !!! compat "Julia 1.11"
2199 Keyword argument `track_content` requires at least Julia 1.11.
2200 An error is now thrown if `path` is not readable.
2201 """
2202 function include_dependency(path::AbstractString; track_content::Bool=true)
2203 _include_dependency(Main, path, track_content=track_content, path_may_be_dir=true)
2204 return nothing
2205 end
2206
2207 # we throw PrecompilableError when a module doesn't want to be precompiled
2208 import Core: PrecompilableError
2209 function show(io::IO, ex::PrecompilableError)
2210 print(io, "Error when precompiling module, potentially caused by a __precompile__(false) declaration in the module.")
2211 end
2212 precompilableerror(ex::PrecompilableError) = true
2213 precompilableerror(ex::WrappedException) = precompilableerror(ex.error)
2214 precompilableerror(@nospecialize ex) = false
2215
2216 # Call __precompile__(false) at the top of a tile prevent it from being precompiled (false)
2217 """
2218 __precompile__(isprecompilable::Bool)
2219
2220 Specify whether the file calling this function is precompilable, defaulting to `true`.
2221 If a module or file is *not* safely precompilable, it should call `__precompile__(false)` in
2222 order to throw an error if Julia attempts to precompile it.
2223 """
2224 @noinline function __precompile__(isprecompilable::Bool=true)
2225 if !isprecompilable && generating_output()
2226 throw(PrecompilableError())
2227 end
2228 nothing
2229 end
2230
2231 # require always works in Main scope and loads files from node 1
2232 # XXX: (this is deprecated, but still used by Distributed)
2233 const toplevel_load = Ref(true)
2234
2235 const _require_world_age = Ref{UInt}(typemax(UInt))
2236
2237 """
2238 require(into::Module, module::Symbol)
2239
2240 This function is part of the implementation of [`using`](@ref) / [`import`](@ref), if a module is not
2241 already defined in `Main`. It can also be called directly to force reloading a module,
2242 regardless of whether it has been loaded before (for example, when interactively developing
2243 libraries).
2244
2245 Loads a source file, in the context of the `Main` module, on every active node, searching
2246 standard locations for files. `require` is considered a top-level operation, so it sets the
2247 current `include` path but does not use it to search for files (see help for [`include`](@ref)).
2248 This function is typically used to load library code, and is implicitly called by `using` to
2249 load packages.
2250
2251 When searching for files, `require` first looks for package code in the global array
2252 [`LOAD_PATH`](@ref). `require` is case-sensitive on all platforms, including those with
2253 case-insensitive filesystems like macOS and Windows.
2254
2255 For more details regarding code loading, see the manual sections on [modules](@ref modules) and
2256 [parallel computing](@ref code-availability).
2257 """
2258 function require(into::Module, mod::Symbol)
2259 if _require_world_age[] != typemax(UInt)
2260 Base.invoke_in_world(_require_world_age[], __require, into, mod)
2261 else
2262 @invokelatest __require(into, mod)
2263 end
2264 end
2265
2266 function __require(into::Module, mod::Symbol)
2267 if into === Base.__toplevel__ && generating_output(#=incremental=#true)
2268 error("`using/import $mod` outside of a Module detected. Importing a package outside of a module \
2269 is not allowed during package precompilation.")
2270 end
2271 @lock require_lock begin
2272 LOADING_CACHE[] = LoadingCache()
2273 try
2274 uuidkey_env = identify_package_env(into, String(mod))
2275 # Core.println("require($(PkgId(into)), $mod) -> $uuidkey_env")
2276 if uuidkey_env === nothing
2277 where = PkgId(into)
2278 if where.uuid === nothing
2279 hint, dots = begin
2280 if isdefined(into, mod) && getfield(into, mod) isa Module
2281 true, "."
2282 elseif isdefined(parentmodule(into), mod) && getfield(parentmodule(into), mod) isa Module
2283 true, ".."
2284 else
2285 false, ""
2286 end
2287 end
2288 hint_message = hint ? ", maybe you meant `import/using $(dots)$(mod)`" : ""
2289 install_message = if mod != :Pkg
2290 start_sentence = hint ? "Otherwise, run" : "Run"
2291 "\n- $start_sentence `import Pkg; Pkg.add($(repr(String(mod))))` to install the $mod package."
2292 else # for some reason Pkg itself isn't availability so do not tell them to use Pkg to install it.
2293 ""
2294 end
2295
2296 throw(ArgumentError("Package $mod not found in current path$hint_message.$install_message"))
2297 else
2298 manifest_warnings = collect_manifest_warnings()
2299 throw(ArgumentError("""
2300 Package $(where.name) does not have $mod in its dependencies:
2301 $manifest_warnings- You may have a partially installed environment. Try `Pkg.instantiate()`
2302 to ensure all packages in the environment are installed.
2303 - Or, if you have $(where.name) checked out for development and have
2304 added $mod as a dependency but haven't updated your primary
2305 environment's manifest file, try `Pkg.resolve()`.
2306 - Otherwise you may need to report an issue with $(where.name)"""))
2307 end
2308 end
2309 uuidkey, env = uuidkey_env
2310 if _track_dependencies[]
2311 path = binpack(uuidkey)
2312 push!(_require_dependencies, (into, path, UInt64(0), UInt32(0), 0.0))
2313 end
2314 return _require_prelocked(uuidkey, env)
2315 finally
2316 LOADING_CACHE[] = nothing
2317 end
2318 end
2319 end
2320
2321 function find_unsuitable_manifests_versions()
2322 unsuitable_manifests = String[]
2323 dev_manifests = String[]
2324 for env in load_path()
2325 project_file = env_project_file(env)
2326 project_file isa String || continue # no project file
2327 manifest_file = project_file_manifest_path(project_file)
2328 manifest_file isa String || continue # no manifest file
2329 m = parsed_toml(manifest_file)
2330 man_julia_version = get(m, "julia_version", nothing)
2331 man_julia_version isa String || @goto mark
2332 man_julia_version = VersionNumber(man_julia_version)
2333 thispatch(man_julia_version) != thispatch(VERSION) && @goto mark
2334 isempty(man_julia_version.prerelease) != isempty(VERSION.prerelease) && @goto mark
2335 isempty(man_julia_version.prerelease) && continue
2336 man_julia_version.prerelease[1] != VERSION.prerelease[1] && @goto mark
2337 if VERSION.prerelease[1] == "DEV"
2338 # manifests don't store the 2nd part of prerelease, so cannot check further
2339 # so treat them specially in the warning
2340 push!(dev_manifests, manifest_file)
2341 end
2342 continue
2343 @label mark
2344 push!(unsuitable_manifests, string(manifest_file, " (v", man_julia_version, ")"))
2345 end
2346 return unsuitable_manifests, dev_manifests
2347 end
2348
2349 function collect_manifest_warnings()
2350 unsuitable_manifests, dev_manifests = find_unsuitable_manifests_versions()
2351 msg = ""
2352 if !isempty(unsuitable_manifests)
2353 msg *= """
2354 - Note that the following manifests in the load path were resolved with a different
2355 julia version, which may be the cause of the error. Try to re-resolve them in the
2356 current version, or consider deleting them if that fails:
2357 $(join(unsuitable_manifests, "\n "))
2358 """
2359 end
2360 if !isempty(dev_manifests)
2361 msg *= """
2362 - Note that the following manifests in the load path were resolved with a potentially
2363 different DEV version of the current version, which may be the cause of the error.
2364 Try to re-resolve them in the current version, or consider deleting them if that fails:
2365 $(join(dev_manifests, "\n "))
2366 """
2367 end
2368 return msg
2369 end
2370
2371 require(uuidkey::PkgId) = @lock require_lock _require_prelocked(uuidkey)
2372
2373 function _require_prelocked(uuidkey::PkgId, env=nothing)
2374 if _require_world_age[] != typemax(UInt)
2375 Base.invoke_in_world(_require_world_age[], __require_prelocked, uuidkey, env)
2376 else
2377 @invokelatest __require_prelocked(uuidkey, env)
2378 end
2379 end
2380
2381 function __require_prelocked(uuidkey::PkgId, env=nothing)
2382 assert_havelock(require_lock)
2383 m = start_loading(uuidkey, UInt128(0), true)
2384 if m === nothing
2385 last = toplevel_load[]
2386 try
2387 toplevel_load[] = false
2388 m = _require(uuidkey, env)
2389 if m === nothing
2390 error("package `$(uuidkey.name)` did not define the expected \
2391 module `$(uuidkey.name)`, check for typos in package module name")
2392 end
2393 finally
2394 toplevel_load[] = last
2395 end_loading(uuidkey, m)
2396 end
2397 insert_extension_triggers(uuidkey)
2398 # After successfully loading, notify downstream consumers
2399 run_package_callbacks(uuidkey)
2400 else
2401 newm = root_module(uuidkey)
2402 end
2403 return m
2404 end

2406 mutable struct PkgOrigin
2407 path::Union{String,Nothing}
2408 cachepath::Union{String,Nothing}
2409 version::Union{VersionNumber,Nothing}
2410 end
2411 PkgOrigin() = PkgOrigin(nothing, nothing, nothing)
2412 const pkgorigins = Dict{PkgId,PkgOrigin}()
2413
2414 const loaded_modules = Dict{PkgId,Module}() # available to be explicitly loaded
2415 const loaded_precompiles = Dict{PkgId,Vector{Module}}() # extended (complete) list of modules, available to be loaded
2416 const loaded_modules_order = Vector{Module}()
2417 const module_keys = IdDict{Module,PkgId}() # the reverse of loaded_modules
2418
2419 is_root_module(m::Module) = @lock require_lock haskey(module_keys, m)
2420 root_module_key(m::Module) = @lock require_lock module_keys[m]
2421
2422 function maybe_loaded_precompile(key::PkgId, buildid::UInt128)
2423 @lock require_lock begin
2424 mods = get(loaded_precompiles, key, nothing)
2425 mods === nothing && return
2426 for mod in mods
2427 module_build_id(mod) == buildid && return mod
2428 end
2429 end
2430 end
2431
2432 function module_build_id(m::Module)
2433 hi, lo = ccall(:jl_module_build_id, NTuple{2,UInt64}, (Any,), m)
2434 return (UInt128(hi) << 64) | lo
2435 end
2436
2437 @constprop :none function register_root_module(m::Module)
2438 # n.b. This is called from C after creating a new module in `Base.__toplevel__`,
2439 # instead of adding them to the binding table there.
2440 @lock require_lock begin
2441 key = PkgId(m, String(nameof(m)))
2442 if haskey(loaded_modules, key)
2443 oldm = loaded_modules[key]
2444 if oldm !== m
2445 if generating_output(#=incremental=#true)
2446 error("Replacing module `$(key.name)`")
2447 else
2448 @warn "Replacing module `$(key.name)`"
2449 end
2450 end
2451 end
2452 maybe_loaded_precompile(key, module_build_id(m)) === nothing && push!(loaded_modules_order, m)
2453 loaded_modules[key] = m
2454 module_keys[m] = key
2455 end
2456 nothing
2457 end
2458
2459 register_root_module(Core)
2460 register_root_module(Base)
2461 register_root_module(Main)
2462
2463 # This is used as the current module when loading top-level modules.
2464 # It has the special behavior that modules evaluated in it get added
2465 # to the loaded_modules table instead of getting bindings.
2466 baremodule __toplevel__
2467 using Base
2468 end
2469
2470 # get a top-level Module from the given key
2471 root_module(key::PkgId) = @lock require_lock loaded_modules[key]
2472 function root_module(where::Module, name::Symbol)
2473 key = identify_package(where, String(name))
2474 key isa PkgId || throw(KeyError(name))
2475 return root_module(key)
2476 end
2477 maybe_root_module(key::PkgId) = @lock require_lock get(loaded_modules, key, nothing)
2478
2479 root_module_exists(key::PkgId) = @lock require_lock haskey(loaded_modules, key)
2480 loaded_modules_array() = @lock require_lock copy(loaded_modules_order)
2481
2482 # after unreference_module, a subsequent require call will try to load a new copy of it, if stale
2483 # reload(m) = (unreference_module(m); require(m))
2484 function unreference_module(key::PkgId)

2492 # whoever takes the package_locks[pkg] must call this function immediately
2493 function set_pkgorigin_version_path(pkg::PkgId, path::String)
2494 assert_havelock(require_lock)
2495 pkgorigin = get!(PkgOrigin, pkgorigins, pkg)
2496 # Pkg needs access to the version of packages in the sysimage.
2497 if generating_output(#=incremental=#false)
2498 pkgorigin.version = get_pkgversion_from_path(joinpath(dirname(path), ".."))
2499 end
2500 pkgorigin.path = path
2501 nothing
2502 end

2504 # Unused
2505 const PKG_PRECOMPILE_HOOK = Ref{Function}()
2506 disable_parallel_precompile::Bool = false
2507
2508 # Returns `nothing` or the new(ish) module
2509 function _require(pkg::PkgId, env=nothing)
2510 assert_havelock(require_lock)
2511
2512 # perform the search operation to select the module file require intends to load
2513 path = locate_package(pkg, env)
2514 if path === nothing
2515 throw(ArgumentError("""
2516 Package $(repr("text/plain", pkg)) is required but does not seem to be installed:
2517 - Run `Pkg.instantiate()` to install all recorded dependencies.
2518 """))
2519 end
2520 set_pkgorigin_version_path(pkg, path)
2521
2522 parallel_precompile_attempted = false # being safe to avoid getting stuck in a precompilepkgs loop
2523 reasons = Dict{String,Int}()
2524 # attempt to load the module file via the precompile cache locations
2525 if JLOptions().use_compiled_modules != 0
2526 @label load_from_cache
2527 loaded = _require_search_from_serialized(pkg, path, UInt128(0), true; reasons)
2528 if loaded isa Module
2529 return loaded
2530 end
2531 end
2532
2533 if JLOptions().use_compiled_modules == 3
2534 error("Precompiled image $pkg not available with flags $(CacheFlags())")
2535 end
2536
2537 # if the module being required was supposed to have a particular version
2538 # but it was not handled by the precompile loader, complain
2539 for (concrete_pkg, concrete_build_id) in _concrete_dependencies
2540 if pkg == concrete_pkg
2541 @warn """Module $(pkg.name) with build ID $((UUID(concrete_build_id))) is missing from the cache.
2542 This may mean $(repr("text/plain", pkg)) does not support precompilation but is imported by a module that does."""
2543 if JLOptions().incremental != 0
2544 # during incremental precompilation, this should be fail-fast
2545 throw(PrecompilableError())
2546 end
2547 end
2548 end
2549
2550 if JLOptions().use_compiled_modules == 1
2551 if !generating_output(#=incremental=#false)
2552 project = active_project()
2553 if !generating_output() && !parallel_precompile_attempted && !disable_parallel_precompile && @isdefined(Precompilation) && project !== nothing &&
2554 isfile(project) && project_file_manifest_path(project) !== nothing
2555 parallel_precompile_attempted = true
2556 unlock(require_lock)
2557 try
2558 Precompilation.precompilepkgs([pkg.name]; _from_loading=true, ignore_loaded=false)
2559 finally
2560 lock(require_lock)
2561 end
2562 @goto load_from_cache
2563 end
2564 # spawn off a new incremental pre-compile task for recursive `require` calls
2565 loaded = maybe_cachefile_lock(pkg, path) do
2566 # double-check the search now that we have lock
2567 m = _require_search_from_serialized(pkg, path, UInt128(0), true)
2568 m isa Module && return m
2569 triggers = get(EXT_PRIMED, pkg, nothing)
2570 loadable_exts = nothing
2571 if triggers !== nothing # extension
2572 loadable_exts = PkgId[]
2573 for (ext′, triggers′) in EXT_PRIMED
2574 if triggers′ ⊊ triggers
2575 push!(loadable_exts, ext′)
2576 end
2577 end
2578 end
2579 return compilecache(pkg, path; reasons, loadable_exts)
2580 end
2581 loaded isa Module && return loaded
2582 if isnothing(loaded) # maybe_cachefile_lock returns nothing if it had to wait for another process
2583 @goto load_from_cache # the new cachefile will have the newest mtime so will come first in the search
2584 elseif isa(loaded, Exception)
2585 if precompilableerror(loaded)
2586 verbosity = isinteractive() ? CoreLogging.Info : CoreLogging.Debug
2587 @logmsg verbosity "Skipping precompilation due to precompilable error. Importing $(repr("text/plain", pkg))." exception=loaded
2588 else
2589 @warn "The call to compilecache failed to create a usable precompiled cache file for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))" exception=loaded
2590 end
2591 # fall-through to loading the file locally if not incremental
2592 else
2593 cachefile, ocachefile = loaded::Tuple{String, Union{Nothing, String}}
2594 loaded = _tryrequire_from_serialized(pkg, cachefile, ocachefile)
2595 if !isa(loaded, Module)
2596 @warn "The call to compilecache failed to create a usable precompiled cache file for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))" exception=loaded
2597 else
2598 return loaded
2599 end
2600 end
2601 if JLOptions().incremental != 0
2602 # during incremental precompilation, this should be fail-fast
2603 throw(PrecompilableError())
2604 end
2605 end
2606 end
2607
2608 # just load the file normally via include
2609 # for unknown dependencies
2610 uuid = pkg.uuid
2611 uuid = (uuid === nothing ? (UInt64(0), UInt64(0)) : convert(NTuple{2, UInt64}, uuid))
2612 old_uuid = ccall(:jl_module_uuid, NTuple{2, UInt64}, (Any,), __toplevel__)
2613 if uuid !== old_uuid
2614 ccall(:jl_set_module_uuid, Cvoid, (Any, NTuple{2, UInt64}), __toplevel__, uuid)
2615 end
2616 unlock(require_lock)
2617 try
2618 include(__toplevel__, path)
2619 loaded = get(loaded_modules, pkg, nothing)
2620 finally
2621 lock(require_lock)
2622 if uuid !== old_uuid
2623 ccall(:jl_set_module_uuid, Cvoid, (Any, NTuple{2, UInt64}), __toplevel__, old_uuid)
2624 end
2625 end
2626 return loaded
2627 end

2633 newm = _tryrequire_from_serialized(uuidkey, path, ocachepath)
2634 newm isa Module || throw(newm)
2635 insert_extension_triggers(uuidkey)

2637 run_package_callbacks(uuidkey)

2707 Like [`include`](@ref), except reads code from the given string rather than from a file.

2711 actually evaluates `mapexpr(expr)`. If it is omitted, `mapexpr` defaults to [`identity`](@ref).

1 (100.00%) samples spent in include_string

2722 result = nothing
2723 line_and_ex = Expr(:toplevel, loc, nothing)

2729 end
2730 ex = mapexpr(ex)
2731 # Wrap things to be eval'd in a :toplevel expr to carry line
2732 # information as part of the expr.

2734 1 (100.00%)
1 (100.00%) samples spent calling eval

2737 catch exc
2738 # TODO: Now that stacktraces are more reliable we should remove
2739 # LoadError and expose the real error type directly.
2740 rethrow(LoadError(filename, loc.line, exc))
2741 end

2764 Base.include([mapexpr::Function,] m::Module, path::AbstractString)
2765
2766 Evaluate the contents of the input source file in the global scope of module `m`.
2767 Every module (except those defined with [`baremodule`](@ref)) has its own
2768 definition of `include` omitting the `m` argument, which evaluates the file in that module.
2769 Returns the result of the last evaluated expression of the input file. During including,
2770 a task-local include path is set to the directory containing the file. Nested calls to
2771 `include` will search relative to that path. This function is typically used to load source
2772 interactively, or to combine files in packages that are broken into multiple source files.
2773
2774 The optional first argument `mapexpr` can be used to transform the included code before
2775 it is evaluated: for each parsed expression `expr` in `path`, the `include` function
2776 actually evaluates `mapexpr(expr)`. If it is omitted, `mapexpr` defaults to [`identity`](@ref).
2777
2778 !!! compat "Julia 1.5"
2779 Julia 1.5 is required for passing the `mapexpr` argument.

2783
1 (100.00%) samples spent in _include
0 (ex.), 1 (100.00%) (incl.) when called from include line 562
# Full include() implementation which is used after bootstrap
2784 function _include(mapexpr::Function, mod::Module, _path::AbstractString)
2785 @noinline # Workaround for module availability in _simplify_include_frames
2786 path, prev = _include_dependency(mod, _path)
2787 for callback in include_callbacks # to preserve order, must come before eval in include_string
2788 invokelatest(callback, mod, path)
2789 end
2790 code = read(path, String)
2791 tls = task_local_storage()
2792 tls[:SOURCE_PATH] = path
2793 try
2794 1 (100.00%)
1 (100.00%) samples spent calling include_string
return include_string(mapexpr, mod, code, path)
2795 finally
2796 if prev === nothing
2797 delete!(tls, :SOURCE_PATH)
2798 else
2799 tls[:SOURCE_PATH] = prev
2800 end

2804 """
2805 evalfile(path::AbstractString, args::Vector{String}=String[])
2806
2807 Load the file into an anonymous module using [`include`](@ref), evaluate all expressions,
2808 and return the value of the last expression.
2809 The optional `args` argument can be used to set the input arguments of the script (i.e. the global `ARGS` variable).
2810 Note that definitions (e.g. methods, globals) are evaluated in the anonymous module and do not affect the current module.
2811
2812 # Examples
2813
2814 ```jldoctest
2815 julia> write("testfile.jl", \"\"\"
2816 @show ARGS
2817 1 + 1
2818 \"\"\");
2819
2820 julia> x = evalfile("testfile.jl", ["ARG1", "ARG2"]);
2821 ARGS = ["ARG1", "ARG2"]
2822
2823 julia> x
2824 2
2825
2826 julia> rm("testfile.jl")
2827 ```
2828 """
2829 function evalfile(path::AbstractString, args::Vector{String}=String[])
2830 return Core.eval(Module(:__anon__),
2831 Expr(:toplevel,
2832 :(const ARGS = $args),
2833 :(eval(x) = $(Expr(:core, :eval))(__anon__, x)),
2834 :(include(x) = $(Expr(:top, :include))(__anon__, x)),
2835 :(include(mapexpr::Function, x) = $(Expr(:top, :include))(mapexpr, __anon__, x)),
2836 :(include($path))))
2837 end
2838 evalfile(path::AbstractString, args::Vector) = evalfile(path, String[args...])

2860 function include_package_for_output(pkg::PkgId, input::String, depot_path::Vector{String}, dl_load_path::Vector{String}, load_path::Vector{String},
2861 concrete_deps::typeof(_concrete_dependencies), source::Union{Nothing,String})
2862

2864 append!(empty!(Base.DL_LOAD_PATH), dl_load_path)
2865 append!(empty!(Base.LOAD_PATH), load_path)
2866 ENV["JULIA_LOAD_PATH"] = join(load_path, Sys.iswindows() ? ';' : ':')
2867 set_active_project(nothing)
2868 Base._track_dependencies[] = true
2869 get!(Base.PkgOrigin, Base.pkgorigins, pkg).path = input
2870 append!(empty!(Base._concrete_dependencies), concrete_deps)
2871 uuid_tuple = pkg.uuid === nothing ? (UInt64(0), UInt64(0)) : convert(NTuple{2, UInt64}, pkg.uuid)
2872
2873 ccall(:jl_set_module_uuid, Cvoid, (Any, NTuple{2, UInt64}), Base.__toplevel__, uuid_tuple)

2882 catch ex
2883 precompilableerror(ex) || rethrow()
2884 @debug "Aborting `create_expr_cache'" exception=(ErrorException("Declaration of __precompile__(false) not allowed"), catch_backtrace())
2885 exit(125) # we define status = 125 means PrecompileableError
2886 finally

2904 _pkg_str(_pkg::Vector) = sprint(show, eltype(_pkg); context = :module=>nothing) * "[" * join(map(_pkg_str, _pkg), ",") * "]"

2908 const PRECOMPILE_TRACE_COMPILE = Ref{String}()
2909 function create_expr_cache(pkg::PkgId, input::String, output::String, output_o::Union{Nothing, String},
2910 concrete_deps::typeof(_concrete_dependencies), flags::Cmd=``, cacheflags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags(),
2911 internal_stderr::IO = stderr, internal_stdout::IO = stdout, loadable_exts::Union{Vector{PkgId},Nothing}=nothing)
2912 @nospecialize internal_stderr internal_stdout
2913 rm(output, force=true) # Remove file if it exists
2914 output_o === nothing || rm(output_o, force=true)
2915 depot_path = map(abspath, DEPOT_PATH)
2916 dl_load_path = map(abspath, DL_LOAD_PATH)
2917 load_path = map(abspath, Base.load_path())
2918 # if pkg is a stdlib, append its parent Project.toml to the load path
2919 triggers = get(EXT_PRIMED, pkg, nothing)
2920 if triggers !== nothing
2921 parentid = triggers[1]
2922 for env in load_path
2923 project_file = env_project_file(env)
2924 if project_file === true
2925 _, parent_project_file = entry_point_and_project_file(env, parentid.name)
2926 if parent_project_file !== nothing
2927 parentproj = project_file_name_uuid(parent_project_file, parentid.name)
2928 if parentproj == parentid
2929 push!(load_path, parent_project_file)
2930 end
2931 end
2932 end
2933 end
2934 end
2935 path_sep = Sys.iswindows() ? ';' : ':'
2936 any(path -> path_sep in path, load_path) &&
2937 error("LOAD_PATH entries cannot contain $(repr(path_sep))")
2938
2939 if output_o === nothing
2940 # remove options that make no difference given the other cache options
2941 cacheflags = CacheFlags(cacheflags, opt_level=0)
2942 end
2943 opts = translate_cache_flags(cacheflags, CacheFlags()) # julia_cmd is generated for the running system, and must be fixed if running for precompile instead
2944 if output_o !== nothing
2945 @debug "Generating object cache file for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))"
2946 cpu_target = get(ENV, "JULIA_CPU_TARGET", nothing)
2947 push!(opts, "--output-o", output_o)
2948 else
2949 @debug "Generating cache file for $(repr("text/plain", pkg))"
2950 cpu_target = nothing
2951 end
2952 push!(opts, "--output-ji", output)
2953 isassigned(PRECOMPILE_TRACE_COMPILE) && push!(opts, "--trace-compile=$(PRECOMPILE_TRACE_COMPILE[])")
2954
2955 io = open(pipeline(addenv(`$(julia_cmd(;cpu_target)::Cmd)
2956 $(flags)
2957 $(opts)
2958 --output-incremental=yes
2959 --startup-file=no --history-file=no --warn-overwrite=yes
2960 $(have_color === nothing ? "--color=auto" : have_color ? "--color=yes" : "--color=no")
2961 -`,
2962 "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS" => 1,
2963 "JULIA_NUM_THREADS" => 1),
2964 stderr = internal_stderr, stdout = internal_stdout),
2965 "w", stdout)
2966 # write data over stdin to avoid the (unlikely) case of exceeding max command line size
2967 write(io.in, """
2968 empty!(Base.EXT_DORMITORY) # If we have a custom sysimage with `EXT_DORMITORY` prepopulated
2969 Base.track_nested_precomp($(_pkg_str(vcat(Base.precompilation_stack, pkg))))
2970 Base.loadable_extensions = $(_pkg_str(loadable_exts))
2971 Base.precompiling_extension = $(loading_extension)
2972 Base.precompilation_target = $(_pkg_str(pkg))
2973 Base.include_package_for_output($(_pkg_str(pkg)), $(repr(abspath(input))), $(repr(depot_path)), $(repr(dl_load_path)),
2974 $(repr(load_path)), $(_pkg_str(concrete_deps)), $(repr(source_path(nothing))))
2975 """)
2976 close(io.in)
2977 return io
2978 end
2979
2980 const precompilation_stack = Vector{PkgId}()
2981 # Helpful for debugging when precompilation is unexpectedly nested.
2982 # Enable with `JULIA_DEBUG=nested_precomp`. Note that it expected to be nested in classical code-load precompilation
2983 # TODO: Add detection if extension precompilation is nested and error / return early?
2984 function track_nested_precomp(pkgs::Vector{PkgId})
2985 append!(precompilation_stack, pkgs)
2986 if length(precompilation_stack) > 1
2987 list() = join(map(p->p.name, precompilation_stack), " > ")
2988 @debug "Nested precompilation: $(list())" _group=:nested_precomp
2989 end
2990 end

2996
2997 function compilecache_path(pkg::PkgId, prefs_hash::UInt64; flags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags(), project::String=something(Base.active_project(), ""))::String
2998 entrypath, entryfile = cache_file_entry(pkg)
2999 cachepath = joinpath(DEPOT_PATH[1], entrypath)
3000 isdir(cachepath) || mkpath(cachepath)
3001 if pkg.uuid === nothing
3002 abspath(cachepath, entryfile) * ".ji"
3003 else
3004 crc = _crc32c(project)
3005 crc = _crc32c(unsafe_string(JLOptions().image_file), crc)
3006 crc = _crc32c(unsafe_string(JLOptions().julia_bin), crc)
3007 crc = _crc32c(_cacheflag_to_uint8(flags), crc)
3008
3009 cpu_target = get(ENV, "JULIA_CPU_TARGET", nothing)
3010 if cpu_target === nothing
3011 cpu_target = unsafe_string(JLOptions().cpu_target)
3012 end
3013 crc = _crc32c(cpu_target, crc)
3014
3015 crc = _crc32c(prefs_hash, crc)
3016 project_precompile_slug = slug(crc, 5)
3017 abspath(cachepath, string(entryfile, "_", project_precompile_slug, ".ji"))
3018 end
3019 end

3021 """
3022 Base.compilecache(module::PkgId)
3023
3024 Creates a precompiled cache file for a module and all of its dependencies.
3025 This can be used to reduce package load times. Cache files are stored in
3026 `DEPOT_PATH[1]/compiled`. See [Module initialization and precompilation](@ref)
3027 for important notes.
3028 """
3029 function compilecache(pkg::PkgId, internal_stderr::IO = stderr, internal_stdout::IO = stdout; flags::Cmd=``, reasons::Union{Dict{String,Int},Nothing}=Dict{String,Int}(), loadable_exts::Union{Vector{PkgId},Nothing}=nothing)
3030 @nospecialize internal_stderr internal_stdout
3031 path = locate_package(pkg)
3032 path === nothing && throw(ArgumentError("$(repr("text/plain", pkg)) not found during precompilation"))
3033 return compilecache(pkg, path, internal_stderr, internal_stdout; flags, reasons, loadable_exts)
3034 end
3035
3036 const MAX_NUM_PRECOMPILE_FILES = Ref(10)
3037
3038 function compilecache(pkg::PkgId, path::String, internal_stderr::IO = stderr, internal_stdout::IO = stdout,
3039 keep_loaded_modules::Bool = true; flags::Cmd=``, cacheflags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags(),
3040 reasons::Union{Dict{String,Int},Nothing}=Dict{String,Int}(), loadable_exts::Union{Vector{PkgId},Nothing}=nothing)
3041
3042 @nospecialize internal_stderr internal_stdout
3043 # decide where to put the resulting cache file
3044 cachepath = compilecache_dir(pkg)
3045
3046 # build up the list of modules that we want the precompile process to preserve
3047 if keep_loaded_modules
3048 concrete_deps = copy(_concrete_dependencies)
3049 for (pkgreq, modreq) in loaded_modules
3050 if !(pkgreq === Main || pkgreq === Core || pkgreq === Base)
3051 push!(concrete_deps, pkgreq => module_build_id(modreq))
3052 end
3053 end
3054 else
3055 concrete_deps = empty(_concrete_dependencies)
3056 end
3057 # run the expression and cache the result
3058 verbosity = isinteractive() ? CoreLogging.Info : CoreLogging.Debug
3059 @logmsg verbosity "Precompiling $(repr("text/plain", pkg)) $(list_reasons(reasons))"
3060
3061 # create a temporary file in `cachepath` directory, write the cache in it,
3062 # write the checksum, _and then_ atomically move the file to `cachefile`.
3063 mkpath(cachepath)
3064 cache_objects = JLOptions().use_pkgimages == 1
3065 tmppath, tmpio = mktemp(cachepath)
3066
3067 if cache_objects
3068 tmppath_o, tmpio_o = mktemp(cachepath)
3069 tmppath_so, tmpio_so = mktemp(cachepath)
3070 else
3071 tmppath_o = nothing
3072 end
3073 local p
3074 try
3075 close(tmpio)
3076 if cache_objects
3077 close(tmpio_o)
3078 close(tmpio_so)
3079 end
3080 p = create_expr_cache(pkg, path, tmppath, tmppath_o, concrete_deps, flags, cacheflags, internal_stderr, internal_stdout, loadable_exts)
3081
3082 if success(p)
3083 if cache_objects
3084 # Run linker over tmppath_o
3085 Linking.link_image(tmppath_o, tmppath_so)
3086 end
3087
3088 # Read preferences hash back from .ji file (we can't precompute because
3089 # we don't actually know what the list of compile-time preferences are without compiling)
3090 prefs_hash = preferences_hash(tmppath)
3091 cachefile = compilecache_path(pkg, prefs_hash; flags=cacheflags)
3092 ocachefile = cache_objects ? ocachefile_from_cachefile(cachefile) : nothing
3093
3094 # append checksum for so to the end of the .ji file:
3095 crc_so = UInt32(0)
3096 if cache_objects
3097 crc_so = open(_crc32c, tmppath_so, "r")
3098 end
3099
3100 # append extra crc to the end of the .ji file:
3101 open(tmppath, "r+") do f
3102 if iszero(isvalid_cache_header(f))
3103 error("Incompatible header for $(repr("text/plain", pkg)) in new cache file $(repr(tmppath)).")
3104 end
3105 seekend(f)
3106 write(f, crc_so)
3107 seekstart(f)
3108 write(f, _crc32c(f))
3109 end
3110
3111 # inherit permission from the source file (and make them writable)
3112 chmod(tmppath, filemode(path) & 0o777 | 0o200)
3113
3114 # prune the directory with cache files
3115 if pkg.uuid !== nothing
3116 entrypath, entryfile = cache_file_entry(pkg)
3117 cachefiles = filter!(x -> startswith(x, entryfile * "_") && endswith(x, ".ji"), readdir(cachepath))
3118 if length(cachefiles) >= MAX_NUM_PRECOMPILE_FILES[]
3119 idx = findmin(mtime.(joinpath.(cachepath, cachefiles)))[2]
3120 evicted_cachefile = joinpath(cachepath, cachefiles[idx])
3121 @debug "Evicting file from cache" evicted_cachefile
3122 rm(evicted_cachefile; force=true)
3123 try
3124 rm(ocachefile_from_cachefile(evicted_cachefile); force=true)
3125 @static if Sys.isapple()
3126 rm(ocachefile_from_cachefile(evicted_cachefile) * ".dSYM"; force=true, recursive=true)
3127 end
3128 catch e
3129 e isa IOError || rethrow()
3130 end
3131 end
3132 end
3133
3134 if cache_objects
3135 try
3136 rename(tmppath_so, ocachefile::String; force=true)
3137 catch e
3138 e isa IOError || rethrow()
3139 isfile(ocachefile::String) || rethrow()
3140 # Windows prevents renaming a file that is in use so if there is a Julia session started
3141 # with a package image loaded, we cannot rename that file.
3142 # The code belows append a `_i` to the name of the cache file where `i` is the smallest number such that
3143 # that cache file does not exist.
3144 ocachename, ocacheext = splitext(ocachefile::String)
3145 old_cachefiles = Set(readdir(cachepath))
3146 num = 1
3147 while true
3148 ocachefile = ocachename * "_$num" * ocacheext
3149 in(basename(ocachefile), old_cachefiles) || break
3150 num += 1
3151 end
3152 # TODO: Risk for a race here if some other process grabs this name before us
3153 cachefile = cachefile_from_ocachefile(ocachefile)
3154 rename(tmppath_so, ocachefile::String; force=true)
3155 end
3156 @static if Sys.isapple()
3157 run(`$(Linking.dsymutil()) $ocachefile`, Base.DevNull(), Base.DevNull(), Base.DevNull())
3158 end
3159 end
3160 # this is atomic according to POSIX (not Win32):
3161 rename(tmppath, cachefile; force=true)
3162 return cachefile, ocachefile
3163 end
3164 finally
3165 rm(tmppath, force=true)
3166 if cache_objects
3167 rm(tmppath_o::String, force=true)
3168 rm(tmppath_so, force=true)
3169 end
3170 end
3171 if p.exitcode == 125
3172 return PrecompilableError()
3173 else
3174 error("Failed to precompile $(repr("text/plain", pkg)) to $(repr(tmppath)).")
3175 end
3176 end
3177
3178 function isvalid_cache_header(f::IOStream)
3179 pkgimage = Ref{UInt8}()
3180 checksum = ccall(:jl_read_verify_header, UInt64, (Ptr{Cvoid}, Ptr{UInt8}, Ptr{Int64}, Ptr{Int64}), f.ios, pkgimage, Ref{Int64}(), Ref{Int64}()) # returns checksum id or zero
3181
3182 if !iszero(checksum) && pkgimage[] != 0
3183 @debug "Cache header was for pkgimage"
3184 return UInt64(0) # We somehow read the header for a pkgimage and not a ji
3185 end
3186 return checksum
3187 end
3188 isvalid_file_crc(f::IOStream) = (_crc32c(seekstart(f), filesize(f) - 4) == read(f, UInt32))
3189
3190 function isvalid_pkgimage_crc(f::IOStream, ocachefile::String)
3191 seekstart(f) # TODO necessary
3192 seek(f, filesize(f) - 8)
3193 expected_crc_so = read(f, UInt32)
3194 crc_so = open(_crc32c, ocachefile, "r")
3195 expected_crc_so == crc_so
3196 end
3197
3198 mutable struct CacheHeaderIncludes
3199 const id::PkgId
3200 filename::String
3201 const fsize::UInt64
3202 const hash::UInt32
3203 const mtime::Float64
3204 const modpath::Vector{String} # seemingly not needed in Base, but used by Revise
3205 end
3206
3207 function replace_depot_path(path::AbstractString, depots::Vector{String}=normalize_depots_for_relocation())
3208 for depot in depots
3209 if startswith(path, string(depot, Filesystem.pathsep())) || path == depot
3210 path = replace(path, depot => "@depot"; count=1)
3211 break
3212 end
3213 end
3214 return path
3215 end
3216
3217 function normalize_depots_for_relocation()
3218 depots = String[]
3219 sizehint!(depots, length(DEPOT_PATH))
3220 for d in DEPOT_PATH
3221 isdir(d) || continue
3222 if isdirpath(d)
3223 d = dirname(d)
3224 end
3225 push!(depots, abspath(d))
3226 end
3227 return depots
3228 end
3229
3230 function restore_depot_path(path::AbstractString, depot::AbstractString)
3231 replace(path, r"^@depot" => depot; count=1)
3232 end
3233
3234 function resolve_depot(inc::AbstractString)
3235 startswith(inc, string("@depot", Filesystem.pathsep())) || return :not_relocatable
3236 for depot in DEPOT_PATH
3237 ispath(restore_depot_path(inc, depot)) && return depot
3238 end
3239 return :no_depot_found
3240 end
3241
3242
3243 function _parse_cache_header(f::IO, cachefile::AbstractString)
3244 flags = read(f, UInt8)
3245 modules = Vector{Pair{PkgId, UInt64}}()
3246 while true
3247 n = read(f, Int32)
3248 n == 0 && break
3249 sym = String(read(f, n)) # module name
3250 uuid = UUID((read(f, UInt64), read(f, UInt64))) # pkg UUID
3251 build_id = read(f, UInt64) # build UUID (mostly just a timestamp)
3252 push!(modules, PkgId(uuid, sym) => build_id)
3253 end
3254 totbytes = Int64(read(f, UInt64)) # total bytes for file dependencies + preferences
3255 # read the list of requirements
3256 # and split the list into include and requires statements
3257 includes = CacheHeaderIncludes[]
3258 requires = Pair{PkgId, PkgId}[]
3259 while true
3260 n2 = read(f, Int32)
3261 totbytes -= 4
3262 if n2 == 0
3263 break
3264 end
3265 depname = String(read(f, n2))
3266 totbytes -= n2
3267 fsize = read(f, UInt64)
3268 totbytes -= 8
3269 hash = read(f, UInt32)
3270 totbytes -= 4
3271 mtime = read(f, Float64)
3272 totbytes -= 8
3273 n1 = read(f, Int32)
3274 totbytes -= 4
3275 # map ids to keys
3276 modkey = (n1 == 0) ? PkgId("") : modules[n1].first
3277 modpath = String[]
3278 if n1 != 0
3279 # determine the complete module path
3280 while true
3281 n1 = read(f, Int32)
3282 totbytes -= 4
3283 if n1 == 0
3284 break
3285 end
3286 push!(modpath, String(read(f, n1)))
3287 totbytes -= n1
3288 end
3289 end
3290 if depname[1] == '\0'
3291 push!(requires, modkey => binunpack(depname))
3292 else
3293 push!(includes, CacheHeaderIncludes(modkey, depname, fsize, hash, mtime, modpath))
3294 end
3295 end
3296 prefs = String[]
3297 while true
3298 n2 = read(f, Int32)
3299 totbytes -= 4
3300 if n2 == 0
3301 break
3302 end
3303 push!(prefs, String(read(f, n2)))
3304 totbytes -= n2
3305 end
3306 prefs_hash = read(f, UInt64)
3307 totbytes -= 8
3308 srctextpos = read(f, Int64)
3309 totbytes -= 8
3310 @assert totbytes == 0 "header of cache file appears to be corrupt (totbytes == $(totbytes))"
3311 # read the list of modules that are required to be present during loading
3312 required_modules = Vector{Pair{PkgId, UInt128}}()
3313 while true
3314 n = read(f, Int32)
3315 n == 0 && break
3316 sym = String(read(f, n)) # module name
3317 uuid = UUID((read(f, UInt64), read(f, UInt64))) # pkg UUID
3318 build_id = UInt128(read(f, UInt64)) << 64
3319 build_id |= read(f, UInt64)
3320 push!(required_modules, PkgId(uuid, sym) => build_id)
3321 end
3322 l = read(f, Int32)
3323 clone_targets = read(f, l)
3324
3325 srcfiles = srctext_files(f, srctextpos, includes)
3326
3327 return modules, (includes, srcfiles, requires), required_modules, srctextpos, prefs, prefs_hash, clone_targets, flags
3328 end
3329
3330 function parse_cache_header(f::IO, cachefile::AbstractString)
3331 modules, (includes, srcfiles, requires), required_modules,
3332 srctextpos, prefs, prefs_hash, clone_targets, flags = _parse_cache_header(f, cachefile)
3333
3334 includes_srcfiles = CacheHeaderIncludes[]
3335 includes_depfiles = CacheHeaderIncludes[]
3336 for inc in includes
3337 if inc.filename ∈ srcfiles
3338 push!(includes_srcfiles, inc)
3339 else
3340 push!(includes_depfiles, inc)
3341 end
3342 end
3343
3344
3345 # The @depot resolution logic for include() files:
3346 # 1. If the cache is not relocatable because of an absolute path,
3347 # we ignore that path for the depot search.
3348 # Recompilation will be triggered by stale_cachefile() if that absolute path does not exist.
3349 # 2. If we can't find a depot for a relocatable path,
3350 # we still replace it with the depot we found from other files.
3351 # Recompilation will be triggered by stale_cachefile() because the resolved path does not exist.
3352 # 3. We require that relocatable paths all resolve to the same depot.
3353 # 4. We explicitly check that all relocatable paths resolve to the same depot. This has two reasons:
3354 # - We want to scan all source files in order to provide logs for 1. and 2. above.
3355 # - It is possible that a depot might be missing source files.
3356 # Assume that we have two depots on DEPOT_PATH, depot_complete and depot_incomplete.
3357 # If DEPOT_PATH=["depot_complete","depot_incomplete"] then no recompilation shall happen,
3358 # because depot_complete will be picked.
3359 # If DEPOT_PATH=["depot_incomplete","depot_complete"] we trigger recompilation and
3360 # hopefully a meaningful error about missing files is thrown.
3361 # If we were to just select the first depot we find, then whether recompilation happens would
3362 # depend on whether the first relocatable file resolves to depot_complete or depot_incomplete.
3363 srcdepot = nothing
3364 any_not_relocatable = false
3365 any_no_depot_found = false
3366 multiple_depots_found = false
3367 for src in srcfiles
3368 depot = resolve_depot(src)
3369 if depot === :not_relocatable
3370 any_not_relocatable = true
3371 elseif depot === :no_depot_found
3372 any_no_depot_found = true
3373 elseif isnothing(srcdepot)
3374 srcdepot = depot
3375 elseif depot != srcdepot
3376 multiple_depots_found = true
3377 end
3378 end
3379 if any_no_depot_found
3380 @debug("Unable to resolve @depot tag for at least one include() file from cache file $cachefile", srcfiles, _group=:relocatable)
3381 end
3382 if any_not_relocatable
3383 @debug("At least one include() file from $cachefile is not relocatable", srcfiles, _group=:relocatable)
3384 end
3385 if multiple_depots_found
3386 @debug("Some include() files from $cachefile are distributed over multiple depots", srcfiles, _group=:relocatable)
3387 elseif !isnothing(srcdepot)
3388 for inc in includes_srcfiles
3389 inc.filename = restore_depot_path(inc.filename, srcdepot)
3390 end
3391 end
3392
3393 # unlike include() files, we allow each relocatable include_dependency() file to resolve
3394 # to a separate depot, #52161
3395 for inc in includes_depfiles
3396 depot = resolve_depot(inc.filename)
3397 if depot === :no_depot_found
3398 @debug("Unable to resolve @depot tag for include_dependency() file $(inc.filename) from cache file $cachefile", _group=:relocatable)
3399 elseif depot === :not_relocatable
3400 @debug("include_dependency() file $(inc.filename) from $cachefile is not relocatable", _group=:relocatable)
3401 else
3402 inc.filename = restore_depot_path(inc.filename, depot)
3403 end
3404 end
3405
3406 return modules, (includes, includes_srcfiles, requires), required_modules, srctextpos, prefs, prefs_hash, clone_targets, flags
3407 end
3408
3409 function parse_cache_header(cachefile::String)
3410 io = open(cachefile, "r")
3411 try
3412 iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io)) && throw(ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $cachefile."))
3413 ret = parse_cache_header(io, cachefile)
3414 return ret
3415 finally
3416 close(io)
3417 end
3418 end
3419
3420 preferences_hash(f::IO, cachefile::AbstractString) = parse_cache_header(f, cachefile)[6]
3421 function preferences_hash(cachefile::String)
3422 io = open(cachefile, "r")
3423 try
3424 if iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io))
3425 throw(ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $cachefile."))
3426 end
3427 return preferences_hash(io, cachefile)
3428 finally
3429 close(io)
3430 end
3431 end

3433 function cache_dependencies(f::IO, cachefile::AbstractString)
3434 _, (includes, _, _), modules, _... = parse_cache_header(f, cachefile)
3435 return modules, map(chi -> chi.filename, includes) # return just filename
3436 end
3437
3438 function cache_dependencies(cachefile::String)
3439 io = open(cachefile, "r")
3440 try
3441 iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io)) && throw(ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $cachefile."))
