3448 function read_dependency_src(io::IO, cachefile::AbstractString, filename::AbstractString)
3449 _, (includes, _, _), _, srctextpos, _, _, _, _ = parse_cache_header(io, cachefile)
3450 srctextpos == 0 && error("no source-text stored in cache file")
3451 seek(io, srctextpos)
3452 return _read_dependency_src(io, filename, includes)
3453 end
3454
3455 function _read_dependency_src(io::IO, filename::AbstractString, includes::Vector{CacheHeaderIncludes}=CacheHeaderIncludes[])
3456 while !eof(io)
3457 filenamelen = read(io, Int32)
3458 filenamelen == 0 && break
3459 depotfn = String(read(io, filenamelen))
3460 len = read(io, UInt64)
3461 fn = if !startswith(depotfn, string("@depot", Filesystem.pathsep()))
3462 depotfn
3463 else
3464 basefn = restore_depot_path(depotfn, "")
3465 idx = findfirst(includes) do inc
3466 endswith(inc.filename, basefn)
3467 end
3468 isnothing(idx) ? depotfn : includes[idx].filename
3469 end
3470 if fn == filename
3471 return String(read(io, len))
3472 end
3473 seek(io, position(io) + len)
3474 end
3475 error(filename, " is not stored in the source-text cache")
3476 end
3477
3478 function read_dependency_src(cachefile::String, filename::AbstractString)
3479 io = open(cachefile, "r")
3480 try
3481 iszero(isvalid_cache_header(io)) && throw(ArgumentError("Incompatible header in cache file $cachefile."))
3482 return read_dependency_src(io, cachefile, filename)
3483 finally
3484 close(io)
3485 end
3486 end
3487
3488 function srctext_files(f::IO, srctextpos::Int64, includes::Vector{CacheHeaderIncludes})
3489 files = Set{String}()
3490 srctextpos == 0 && return files
3491 seek(f, srctextpos)
3492 while !eof(f)
3493 filenamelen = read(f, Int32)
3494 filenamelen == 0 && break
3495 filename = String(read(f, filenamelen))
3496 len = read(f, UInt64)
3497 push!(files, filename)
3498 seek(f, position(f) + len)
3499 end
3500 return files
3501 end
3502
3503 # Test to see if this UUID is mentioned in this `Project.toml`; either as
3504 # the top-level UUID (e.g. that of the project itself), as a dependency,
3505 # or as an extra/weakdep for Preferences.
3506 function get_uuid_name(project::Dict{String, Any}, uuid::UUID)
3507 uuid_p = get(project, "uuid", nothing)::Union{Nothing, String}
3508 name = get(project, "name", nothing)::Union{Nothing, String}
3509 if name !== nothing && uuid_p !== nothing && UUID(uuid_p) == uuid
3510 return name
3511 end
3512 deps = get(project, "deps", nothing)::Union{Nothing, Dict{String, Any}}
3513 if deps !== nothing
3514 for (k, v) in deps
3515 if uuid == UUID(v::String)
3516 return k
3517 end
3518 end
3519 end
3520 for subkey in ("deps", "extras", "weakdeps")
3521 subsection = get(project, subkey, nothing)::Union{Nothing, Dict{String, Any}}
3522 if subsection !== nothing
3523 for (k, v) in subsection
3524 if uuid == UUID(v::String)
3525 return k
3526 end
3527 end
3528 end
3529 end
3530 return nothing
3531 end
3532
3533 function get_uuid_name(project_toml::String, uuid::UUID)
3534 project = parsed_toml(project_toml)
3535 return get_uuid_name(project, uuid)
3536 end
3537
3538 # If we've asked for a specific UUID, this function will extract the prefs
3539 # for that particular UUID. Otherwise, it returns all preferences.
3540 function filter_preferences(prefs::Dict{String, Any}, pkg_name)
3541 if pkg_name === nothing
3542 return prefs
3543 else
3544 return get(Dict{String, Any}, prefs, pkg_name)::Dict{String, Any}
3545 end
3546 end
3547
3548 function collect_preferences(project_toml::String, uuid::Union{UUID,Nothing})
3549 # We'll return a list of dicts to be merged
3550 dicts = Dict{String, Any}[]
3551
3552 project = parsed_toml(project_toml)
3553 pkg_name = nothing
3554 if uuid !== nothing
3555 # If we've been given a UUID, map that to the name of the package as
3556 # recorded in the preferences section. If we can't find that mapping,
3557 # exit out, as it means there's no way preferences can be set for that
3558 # UUID, as we only allow actual dependencies to have preferences set.
3559 pkg_name = get_uuid_name(project, uuid)
3560 if pkg_name === nothing
3561 return dicts
3562 end
3563 end
3564
3565 # Look first inside of `Project.toml` to see we have preferences embedded within there
3566 proj_preferences = get(Dict{String, Any}, project, "preferences")::Dict{String, Any}
3567 push!(dicts, filter_preferences(proj_preferences, pkg_name))
3568
3569 # Next, look for `(Julia)LocalPreferences.toml` files next to this `Project.toml`
3570 project_dir = dirname(project_toml)
3571 for name in preferences_names
3572 toml_path = joinpath(project_dir, name)
3573 if isfile(toml_path)
3574 prefs = parsed_toml(toml_path)
3575 push!(dicts, filter_preferences(prefs, pkg_name))
3576
3577 # If we find `JuliaLocalPreferences.toml`, don't look for `LocalPreferences.toml`
3578 break
3579 end
3580 end
3581
3582 return dicts
3583 end
3584
3585 """
3586 recursive_prefs_merge(base::Dict, overrides::Dict...)
3587
3588 Helper function to merge preference dicts recursively, honoring overrides in nested
3589 dictionaries properly.
3590 """
3591 function recursive_prefs_merge(base::Dict{String, Any}, overrides::Dict{String, Any}...)
3592 new_base = Base._typeddict(base, overrides...)
3593
3594 for override in overrides
3595 # Clear entries are keys that should be deleted from any previous setting.
3596 override_clear = get(override, "__clear__", nothing)
3597 if override_clear isa Vector{String}
3598 for k in override_clear
3599 delete!(new_base, k)
3600 end
3601 end
3602
3603 for (k, override_k) in override
3604 # Note that if `base` has a mapping that is _not_ a `Dict`, and `override`
3605 new_base_k = get(new_base, k, nothing)
3606 if new_base_k isa Dict{String, Any} && override_k isa Dict{String, Any}
3607 new_base[k] = recursive_prefs_merge(new_base_k, override_k)
3608 else
3609 new_base[k] = override_k
3610 end
3611 end
3612 end
3613 return new_base
3614 end
3615
3616 function get_preferences(uuid::Union{UUID,Nothing} = nothing)
3617 merged_prefs = Dict{String,Any}()
3618 for env in reverse(load_path())
3619 project_toml = env_project_file(env)
3620 if !isa(project_toml, String)
3621 continue
3622 end
3623
3624 # Collect all dictionaries from the current point in the load path, then merge them in
3625 dicts = collect_preferences(project_toml, uuid)
3626 merged_prefs = recursive_prefs_merge(merged_prefs, dicts...)
3627 end
3628 return merged_prefs
3629 end
3630
3631 function get_preferences_hash(uuid::Union{UUID, Nothing}, prefs_list::Vector{String})
3632 # Start from a predictable hash point to ensure that the same preferences always
3633 # hash to the same value, modulo changes in how Dictionaries are hashed.
3634 h = UInt(0)
3635 uuid === nothing && return UInt64(h)
3636
3637 # Load the preferences
3638 prefs = get_preferences(uuid)
3639
3640 # Walk through each name that's called out as a compile-time preference
3641 for name in prefs_list
3642 prefs_value = get(prefs, name, nothing)
3643 if prefs_value !== nothing
3644 h = hash(prefs_value, h)::UInt
3645 end
3646 end
3647 # We always return a `UInt64` so that our serialization format is stable
3648 return UInt64(h)
3649 end
3650
3651 get_preferences_hash(m::Module, prefs_list::Vector{String}) = get_preferences_hash(PkgId(m).uuid, prefs_list)
3652
3653 # This is how we keep track of who is using what preferences at compile-time
3654 const COMPILETIME_PREFERENCES = Dict{UUID,Set{String}}()
3655
3656 # In `Preferences.jl`, if someone calls `load_preference(@__MODULE__, key)` while we're precompiling,
3657 # we mark that usage as a usage at compile-time and call this method, so that at the end of `.ji` generation,
3658 # we can record the list of compile-time preferences and embed that into the `.ji` header
3659 function record_compiletime_preference(uuid::UUID, key::String)
3660 pref = get!(Set{String}, COMPILETIME_PREFERENCES, uuid)
3661 push!(pref, key)
3662 return nothing
3663 end
3664 get_compiletime_preferences(uuid::UUID) = collect(get(Vector{String}, COMPILETIME_PREFERENCES, uuid))
3665 get_compiletime_preferences(m::Module) = get_compiletime_preferences(PkgId(m).uuid)
3666 get_compiletime_preferences(::Nothing) = String[]
3667
3668 function check_clone_targets(clone_targets)
3669 rejection_reason = ccall(:jl_check_pkgimage_clones, Any, (Ptr{Cchar},), clone_targets)
3670 if rejection_reason !== nothing
3671 return rejection_reason
3672 end
3673 end
3674
3675 # Set by FileWatching.__init__()
3676 global mkpidlock_hook
3677 global trymkpidlock_hook
3678 global parse_pidfile_hook
3679
3680 # The preferences hash is only known after precompilation so just assume no preferences.
3681 # Also ignore the active project, which means that if all other conditions are equal,
3682 # the same package cannot be precompiled from different projects and/or different preferences at the same time.
3683 compilecache_pidfile_path(pkg::PkgId; flags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags()) = compilecache_path(pkg, UInt64(0); project="", flags) * ".pidfile"
3684
3685 const compilecache_pidlock_stale_age = 10
3686
3687 # Allows processes to wait if another process is precompiling a given source already.
3688 # The lock file mtime will be updated when held at most every `stale_age/2` seconds, with expected
3689 # variance of 10 seconds or more being infrequent but not unusual.
3690 # After `stale_age` seconds beyond the mtime of the lock file, the lock file is deleted and
3691 # precompilation will proceed if the locking process no longer exists or after `stale_age * 5`
3692 # seconds if the process does still exist.
3693 # If the lock is held by another host, it will conservatively wait `stale_age * 5`
3694 # seconds since processes cannot be checked remotely
3695 function maybe_cachefile_lock(f, pkg::PkgId, srcpath::String; stale_age=compilecache_pidlock_stale_age)
3696 if @isdefined(mkpidlock_hook) && @isdefined(trymkpidlock_hook) && @isdefined(parse_pidfile_hook)
3697 pidfile = compilecache_pidfile_path(pkg)
3698 cachefile = invokelatest(trymkpidlock_hook, f, pidfile; stale_age)
3699 if cachefile === false
3700 pid, hostname, age = invokelatest(parse_pidfile_hook, pidfile)
3701 verbosity = isinteractive() ? CoreLogging.Info : CoreLogging.Debug
3702 if isempty(hostname) || hostname == gethostname()
3703 @logmsg verbosity "Waiting for another process (pid: $pid) to finish precompiling $(repr("text/plain", pkg)). Pidfile: $pidfile"
3704 else
3705 @logmsg verbosity "Waiting for another machine (hostname: $hostname, pid: $pid) to finish precompiling $(repr("text/plain", pkg)). Pidfile: $pidfile"
3706 end
3707 # wait until the lock is available, but don't actually acquire it
3708 # returning nothing indicates a process waited for another
3709 return invokelatest(mkpidlock_hook, Returns(nothing), pidfile; stale_age)
3710 end
3711 return cachefile
3712 else
3713 # for packages loaded before FileWatching.__init__()
3714 f()
3715 end
3716 end
3717
3718 function record_reason(reasons::Dict{String,Int}, reason::String)
3719 reasons[reason] = get(reasons, reason, 0) + 1
3720 end
3721 record_reason(::Nothing, ::String) = nothing
3722 function list_reasons(reasons::Dict{String,Int})
3723 isempty(reasons) && return ""
3724 return "(cache misses: $(join(("$k ($v)" for (k,v) in reasons), ", ")))"
3725 end
3726 list_reasons(::Nothing) = ""
3727
3728 # returns true if it "cachefile.ji" is stale relative to "modpath.jl" and build_id for modkey
3729 # otherwise returns the list of dependencies to also check
3730 @constprop :none function stale_cachefile(modpath::String, cachefile::String; ignore_loaded::Bool = false, requested_flags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags(), reasons=nothing)
3731 return stale_cachefile(PkgId(""), UInt128(0), modpath, cachefile; ignore_loaded, requested_flags, reasons)
3732 end
3733 @constprop :none function stale_cachefile(modkey::PkgId, build_id::UInt128, modpath::String, cachefile::String;
3734 ignore_loaded::Bool=false, requested_flags::CacheFlags=CacheFlags(),
3735 reasons::Union{Dict{String,Int},Nothing}=nothing, stalecheck::Bool=true)
3736 # n.b.: this function does nearly all of the file validation, not just those checks related to stale, so the name is potentially unclear
3737 io = try
3738 open(cachefile, "r")
3739 catch ex
3740 ex isa IOError || ex isa SystemError || rethrow()
3741 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile for $modkey because it could not be opened" isfile(cachefile)
3742 return true
3743 end
3744 try
3745 checksum = isvalid_cache_header(io)
3746 if iszero(checksum)
3747 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile due to it containing an incompatible cache header"
3748 record_reason(reasons, "incompatible header")
3749 return true # incompatible cache file
3750 end
3751 modules, (includes, _, requires), required_modules, srctextpos, prefs, prefs_hash, clone_targets, actual_flags = parse_cache_header(io, cachefile)
3752 if isempty(modules)
3753 return true # ignore empty file
3754 end
3755 if @ccall(jl_match_cache_flags(_cacheflag_to_uint8(requested_flags)::UInt8, actual_flags::UInt8)::UInt8) == 0
3756 @debug """
3757 Rejecting cache file $cachefile for $modkey since the flags are mismatched
3758 requested flags: $(requested_flags) [$(_cacheflag_to_uint8(requested_flags))]
3759 cache file: $(CacheFlags(actual_flags)) [$actual_flags]
3760 """
3761 record_reason(reasons, "mismatched flags")
3762 return true
3763 end
3764 pkgimage = !isempty(clone_targets)
3765 if pkgimage
3766 ocachefile = ocachefile_from_cachefile(cachefile)
3767 if JLOptions().use_pkgimages == 0
3768 # presence of clone_targets means native code cache
3769 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile for $modkey since it would require usage of pkgimage"
3770 record_reason(reasons, "requires pkgimages")
3771 return true
3772 end
3773 rejection_reasons = check_clone_targets(clone_targets)
3774 if !isnothing(rejection_reasons)
3775 @debug("Rejecting cache file $cachefile for $modkey:",
3776 Reasons=rejection_reasons,
3777 var"Image Targets"=parse_image_targets(clone_targets),
3778 var"Current Targets"=current_image_targets())
3779 record_reason(reasons, "target mismatch")
3780 return true
3781 end
3782 if !isfile(ocachefile)
3783 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile for $modkey since pkgimage $ocachefile was not found"
3784 record_reason(reasons, "missing ocachefile")
3785 return true
3786 end
3787 else
3788 ocachefile = nothing
3789 end
3790 id = first(modules)
3791 if id.first != modkey && modkey != PkgId("")
3792 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile for $modkey since it is for $id instead"
3793 record_reason(reasons, "for different pkgid")
3794 return true
3795 end
3796 id_build = (UInt128(checksum) << 64) | id.second
3797 if build_id != UInt128(0)
3798 if id_build != build_id
3799 @debug "Ignoring cache file $cachefile for $modkey ($((UUID(id_build)))) since it does not provide desired build_id ($((UUID(build_id))))"
3800 record_reason(reasons, "for different buildid")
3801 return true
3802 end
3803 end
3804 id = id.first
3805 modules = Dict{PkgId, UInt64}(modules)
3806
3807 # Check if transitive dependencies can be fulfilled
3808 ndeps = length(required_modules)
3809 depmods = Vector{Any}(undef, ndeps)
3810 for i in 1:ndeps
3811 req_key, req_build_id = required_modules[i]
3812 # Check if module is already loaded
3813 M = stalecheck ? nothing : maybe_loaded_precompile(req_key, req_build_id)
3814 if M !== nothing
3815 @assert PkgId(M) == req_key && module_build_id(M) === req_build_id
3816 depmods[i] = M
3817 elseif root_module_exists(req_key)
3818 M = root_module(req_key)
3819 if PkgId(M) == req_key && module_build_id(M) === req_build_id
3820 depmods[i] = M
3821 elseif M == Core
3822 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because it was made with a different julia version"
3823 record_reason(reasons, "wrong julia version")
3824 return true # Won't be able to fulfill dependency
3825 elseif ignore_loaded || !stalecheck
3826 # Used by Pkg.precompile given that there it's ok to precompile different versions of loaded packages
3827 @goto locate_branch
3828 else
3829 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because module $req_key is already loaded and incompatible."
3830 record_reason(reasons, "wrong dep version loaded")
3831 return true # Won't be able to fulfill dependency
3832 end
3833 else
3834 @label locate_branch
3835 path = locate_package(req_key) # TODO: add env and/or skip this when stalecheck is false
3836 if path === nothing
3837 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because dependency $req_key not found."
3838 record_reason(reasons, "dep missing source")
3839 return true # Won't be able to fulfill dependency
3840 end
3841 depmods[i] = (path, req_key, req_build_id)
3842 end
3843 end
3844
3845 # check if this file is going to provide one of our concrete dependencies
3846 # or if it provides a version that conflicts with our concrete dependencies
3847 # or neither
3848 if stalecheck
3849 for (req_key, req_build_id) in _concrete_dependencies
3850 build_id = get(modules, req_key, UInt64(0))
3851 if build_id !== UInt64(0)
3852 build_id |= UInt128(checksum) << 64
3853 if build_id === req_build_id
3854 stalecheck = false
3855 break
3856 end
3857 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because it provides the wrong build_id (got $((UUID(build_id)))) for $req_key (want $(UUID(req_build_id)))"
3858 record_reason(reasons, "wrong dep buildid")
3859 return true # cachefile doesn't provide the required version of the dependency
3860 end
3861 end
3862 end
3863
3864 # now check if this file's content hash has changed relative to its source files
3865 if stalecheck
3866 if !samefile(includes[1].filename, modpath)
3867 # In certain cases the path rewritten by `fixup_stdlib_path` may
3868 # point to an unreadable directory, make sure we can `stat` the
3869 # file before comparing it with `modpath`.
3870 stdlib_path = fixup_stdlib_path(includes[1].filename)
3871 if !(isreadable(stdlib_path) && samefile(stdlib_path, modpath))
3872 !samefile(fixup_stdlib_path(includes[1].filename), modpath)
3873 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because it is for file $(includes[1].filename) not file $modpath"
3874 record_reason(reasons, "wrong source")
3875 return true # cache file was compiled from a different path
3876 end
3877 end
3878 for (modkey, req_modkey) in requires
3879 # verify that `require(modkey, name(req_modkey))` ==> `req_modkey`
3880 pkg = identify_package(modkey, req_modkey.name)
3881 if pkg != req_modkey
3882 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because uuid mapping for $modkey => $req_modkey has changed, expected $modkey => $(repr("text/plain", pkg))"
3883 record_reason(reasons, "dep uuid changed")
3884 return true
3885 end
3886 end
3887 for chi in includes
3888 f, fsize_req, hash_req, ftime_req = chi.filename, chi.fsize, chi.hash, chi.mtime
3889 if startswith(f, string("@depot", Filesystem.pathsep()))
3890 @debug("Rejecting stale cache file $cachefile because its depot could not be resolved")
3891 record_reason(reasons, "nonresolveable depot")
3892 return true
3893 end
3894 if !ispath(f)
3895 _f = fixup_stdlib_path(f)
3896 if isfile(_f) && startswith(_f, Sys.STDLIB)
3897 continue
3898 end
3899 @debug "Rejecting stale cache file $cachefile because file $f does not exist"
3900 record_reason(reasons, "missing sourcefile")
3901 return true
3902 end
3903 if ftime_req >= 0.0
3904 # this is an include_dependency for which we only recorded the mtime
3905 ftime = mtime(f)
3906 is_stale = ( ftime != ftime_req ) &&
3907 ( ftime != floor(ftime_req) ) && # Issue #13606, PR #13613: compensate for Docker images rounding mtimes
3908 ( ftime != ceil(ftime_req) ) && # PR: #47433 Compensate for CirceCI's truncating of timestamps in its caching
3909 ( ftime != trunc(ftime_req, digits=6) ) && # Issue #20837, PR #20840: compensate for GlusterFS truncating mtimes to microseconds
3910 ( ftime != 1.0 ) && # PR #43090: provide compatibility with Nix mtime.
3911 !( 0 < (ftime_req - ftime) < 1e-6 ) # PR #45552: Compensate for Windows tar giving mtimes that may be incorrect by up to one microsecond
3912 if is_stale
3913 @debug "Rejecting stale cache file $cachefile because mtime of include_dependency $f has changed (mtime $ftime, before $ftime_req)"
3914 record_reason(reasons, "include_dependency mtime change")
3915 return true
3916 end
3917 else
3918 fsize = filesize(f)
3919 if fsize != fsize_req
3920 @debug "Rejecting stale cache file $cachefile because file size of $f has changed (file size $fsize, before $fsize_req)"
3921 record_reason(reasons, "include_dependency fsize change")
3922 return true
3923 end
3924 hash = isdir(f) ? _crc32c(join(readdir(f))) : open(_crc32c, f, "r")
3925 if hash != hash_req
3926 @debug "Rejecting stale cache file $cachefile because hash of $f has changed (hash $hash, before $hash_req)"
3927 record_reason(reasons, "include_dependency fhash change")
3928 return true
3929 end
3930 end
3931 end
3932 end
3933
3934 if !isvalid_file_crc(io)
3935 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because it has an invalid checksum"
3936 record_reason(reasons, "invalid checksum")
3937 return true
3938 end
3939
3940 if pkgimage
3941 if !isvalid_pkgimage_crc(io, ocachefile::String)
3942 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because $ocachefile has an invalid checksum"
3943 record_reason(reasons, "ocachefile invalid checksum")
3944 return true
3945 end
3946 end
3947
3948 curr_prefs_hash = get_preferences_hash(id.uuid, prefs)
3949 if prefs_hash != curr_prefs_hash
3950 @debug "Rejecting cache file $cachefile because preferences hash does not match 0x$(string(prefs_hash, base=16)) != 0x$(string(curr_prefs_hash, base=16))"
3951 record_reason(reasons, "preferences hash mismatch")
3952 return true
3953 end
3954
3955 return depmods, ocachefile, id_build # fresh cachefile
3956 finally
3957 close(io)
3958 end
3959 end

3961 """
3962 @__FILE__ -> String
3963
3964 Expand to a string with the path to the file containing the
3965 macrocall, or an empty string if evaluated by `julia -e <expr>`.
3966 Return `nothing` if the macro was missing parser source information.
3967 Alternatively see [`PROGRAM_FILE`](@ref).
3968 """
3969 macro __FILE__()
3970 __source__.file === nothing && return nothing
3971 return String(__source__.file::Symbol)
3972 end
3973
3974 """
3975 @__DIR__ -> String
3976
3977 Macro to obtain the absolute path of the current directory as a string.
3978
3979 If in a script, returns the directory of the script containing the `@__DIR__` macrocall. If run from a
3980 REPL or if evaluated by `julia -e <expr>`, returns the current working directory.
3981
3982 # Examples
3983
3984 The example illustrates the difference in the behaviors of `@__DIR__` and `pwd()`, by creating
3985 a simple script in a different directory than the current working one and executing both commands:
3986
3987 ```julia-repl
3988 julia> cd("/home/JuliaUser") # working directory
3989
3990 julia> # create script at /home/JuliaUser/Projects
3991 open("/home/JuliaUser/Projects/test.jl","w") do io
3992 print(io, \"\"\"
3993 println("@__DIR__ = ", @__DIR__)
3994 println("pwd() = ", pwd())
3995 \"\"\")
3996 end
3997
3998 julia> # outputs script directory and current working directory
3999 include("/home/JuliaUser/Projects/test.jl")
4000 @__DIR__ = /home/JuliaUser/Projects
4001 pwd() = /home/JuliaUser
4002 ```
4003 """
4004 macro __DIR__()
4005 __source__.file === nothing && return nothing
4006 _dirname = dirname(String(__source__.file::Symbol))
4007 return isempty(_dirname) ? pwd() : abspath(_dirname)
4008 end
4009
4010 """
4011 precompile(f, argtypes::Tuple{Vararg{Any}})
4012
4013 Compile the given function `f` for the argument tuple (of types) `argtypes`, but do not execute it.
4014 """
4015 function precompile(@nospecialize(f), @nospecialize(argtypes::Tuple))
4016 precompile(Tuple{Core.Typeof(f), argtypes...})
4017 end
4018
4019 const ENABLE_PRECOMPILE_WARNINGS = Ref(false)
4020 function precompile(@nospecialize(argt::Type))
4021 ret = ccall(:jl_compile_hint, Int32, (Any,), argt) != 0
4022 if !ret && ENABLE_PRECOMPILE_WARNINGS[]
4023 @warn "Inactive precompile statement" maxlog=100 form=argt _module=nothing _file=nothing _line=0
4024 end
4025 return ret
4026 end
4027
4028 # Variants that work for `invoke`d calls for which the signature may not be sufficient
4029 precompile(mi::Core.MethodInstance, world::UInt=get_world_counter()) =
4030 (ccall(:jl_compile_method_instance, Cvoid, (Any, Ptr{Cvoid}, UInt), mi, C_NULL, world); return true)
4031
4032 """
4033 precompile(f, argtypes::Tuple{Vararg{Any}}, m::Method)
4034
4035 Precompile a specific method for the given argument types. This may be used to precompile
4036 a different method than the one that would ordinarily be chosen by dispatch, thus
4037 mimicking `invoke`.
4038 """
4039 function precompile(@nospecialize(f), @nospecialize(argtypes::Tuple), m::Method)
4040 precompile(Tuple{Core.Typeof(f), argtypes...}, m)
4041 end
4042
4043 function precompile(@nospecialize(argt::Type), m::Method)
4044 atype, sparams = ccall(:jl_type_intersection_with_env, Any, (Any, Any), argt, m.sig)::SimpleVector
4045 mi = Core.Compiler.specialize_method(m, atype, sparams)
4046 return precompile(mi)
4047 end
4048
4049 precompile(include_package_for_output, (PkgId, String, Vector{String}, Vector{String}, Vector{String}, typeof(_concrete_dependencies), Nothing)) || @assert false
4050 precompile(include_package_for_output, (PkgId, String, Vector{String}, Vector{String}, Vector{String}, typeof(_concrete_dependencies), String)) || @assert false
4051 precompile(create_expr_cache, (PkgId, String, String, String, typeof(_concrete_dependencies), Cmd, CacheFlags, IO, IO)) || @assert false
4052 precompile(create_expr_cache, (PkgId, String, String, Nothing, typeof(_concrete_dependencies), Cmd, CacheFlags, IO, IO)) || @assert false
